{
  "path": "core/agents/memory_agent.py",
  "instructions": "Implement real MemoryAgent with analyze() snapshot over memory stores",
  "content": "\"\"\"MemoryAgent — handles memory recall/store sub-goals.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\nfrom core.agents.base import AgentResult, BaseAgent\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass MemorySnapshot:\n    total_memories: int = 0\n    recent: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    timestamp: str = \"\"\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"total_memories\": self.total_memories,\n                \"recent\": list(self.recent), \"timestamp\": self.timestamp}\n\n\nclass MemoryAgent(BaseAgent):\n    \"\"\"Memory operations backed by memory.mem0_adapter (graceful offline).\"\"\"\n\n    agent_id = \"memory\"\n    keywords = [\"remember\", \"recall\", \"memorize\", \"memory\", \"forget\"]\n    priority = 10\n    description = \"Store and recall user memories\"\n\n    def analyze(self) -> MemorySnapshot:\n        \"\"\"Read-only memory snapshot.\"\"\"\n        snapshot = MemorySnapshot(timestamp=datetime.now().isoformat())\n        try:\n            from memory import mem0_adapter\n            all_mems = mem0_adapter.mem0_memory.get_all(\"default\") or []\n            snapshot.total_memories = len(all_mems)\n            snapshot.recent = [\n                str(m.get(\"memory\", m.get(\"text\", \"\")))\n                for m in all_mems[:5]\n                if isinstance(m, dict)\n            ]\n        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — mem0 not installed is normal\n            pass\n        return snapshot\n\n    async def _execute_impl(self, goal: str, context: Optional[Any] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> AgentResult:\n        text = (goal or \"\").lower()\n        snapshot = self.analyze()\n\n        if any(kw in text for kw in (\"remember\", \"memorize\", \"store\")):\n            content = goal\n            try:\n                from memory import mem0_adapter\n                mem0_adapter.mem0_memory.add([{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": content}],\n                                            user_id=\"default\")\n                return AgentResult(success=True, output=f\"Stored memory: {content}\",\n                                   agent_id=self.agent_id)\n            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n                return AgentResult(success=False, output=\"\", agent_id=self.agent_id,\n                                   error=f\"memory store failed: {exc}\")\n\n        lines = [f\"Memory bank: {snapshot.total_memories} entries.\"]\n        lines += [f\"- {m}\" for m in snapshot.recent]\n        if not snapshot.recent:\n            lines.append(\"(no memories stored yet)\")\n        return AgentResult(success=True, output=\"\\n\".join(lines), agent_id=self.agent_id)\n"
}

  "instructions": "Implement real ResearchAgent with analyze() and search-backed research execution",
  "content": "\"\"\"ResearchAgent — handles research sub-goals via search + synthesis.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\nfrom core.agents.base import AgentResult, BaseAgent\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ResearchSnapshot:\n    queries_logged: int = 0\n    last_query: str = \"\"\n    timestamp: str = \"\"\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"queries_logged\": self.queries_logged,\n                \"last_query\": self.last_query, \"timestamp\": self.timestamp}\n\n\nclass ResearchAgent(BaseAgent):\n    \"\"\"Web research backed by tools.search_tool (SearXNG/DuckDuckGo).\"\"\"\n\n    agent_id = \"research\"\n    keywords = [\"research\", \"investigate\", \"explore topic\", \"search for information\"]\n    priority = 10\n    description = \"Web research with source-backed summaries\"\n\n    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any):\n        super().__init__(**kwargs)\n        self.queries_logged = 0\n        self.last_query = \"\"\n\n    def analyze(self) -> ResearchSnapshot:\n        return ResearchSnapshot(\n            queries_logged=self.queries_logged,\n            last_query=self.last_query,\n            timestamp=datetime.now().isoformat(),\n        )\n\n    async def _execute_impl(self, goal: str, context: Optional[Any] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> AgentResult:\n        from core.llm_router import complete_async\n\n        results: list[dict] = []\n        try:\n            from tools.search_fallback import search as _search\n            results = _search(goal, max_results=5) or []\n        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — offline is acceptable\n            results = []\n\n        self.queries_logged += 1\n        self.last_query = goal\n\n        context_block = \"\\n\".join(\n            f\"- {r.get('title', '')}: {r.get('snippet', '')[:200]}\"\n            for r in results[:5] if isinstance(r, dict)\n        ) or \"(no web results — answer from model knowledge)\"\n\n        result = await complete_async(\n            f\"Research question: {goal}\\n\\nWeb findings:\\n{context_block}\\n\\n\"\n            \"Summarize the key findings in 3-5 bullet points.\",\n            role=\"chat\",\n            system=\"You are a research assistant. Be factual and cite sources when given.\",\n        )\n        if result.is_err():\n            return AgentResult(success=False, output=\"\", agent_id=self.agent_id,\n                               error=str(result.unwrap()))\n        return AgentResult(success=True, output=result.unwrap(), agent_id=self.agent_id)\n"
}

field\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\nfrom core.agents.base import AgentResult, BaseAgent\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass TestSnapshot:\n    project_dir: str = \"\"\n    test_files: int = 0\n    timestamp: str = \"\"\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"project_dir\": self.project_dir, \"test_files\": self.test_files,\n                \"timestamp\": self.timestamp}\n\n\nclass TestAgent(BaseAgent):\n    \"\"\"Runs project tests (pytest preferred, unittest fallback).\"\"\"\n\n    agent_id = \"test\"\n    keywords = [\"test\", \"unittest\", \"pytest\", \"run tests\", \"coverage\"]\n    priority = 10\n    description = \"Run project test suites\"\n\n    def analyze(self, project_dir: str = \".\") -> TestSnapshot:\n        p = Path(project_dir)\n        count = 0\n        if p.is_dir():\n            count = sum(1 for f in p.rglob(\"test_*.py\"))\n            count += sum(1 for f in p.rglob(\"*_test.py\"))\n        return TestSnapshot(project_dir=str(p.resolve()), test_files=count,\n                            timestamp=datetime.now().isoformat())\n\n    async def _execute_impl(self, goal: str, context: Optional[Any] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> AgentResult:\n        project_dir = \".\"\n        variables = getattr(context, \"variables\", None) or {}\n        if isinstance(variables, dict):\n            project_dir = str(variables.get(\"project_dir\", \".\"))\n        return await self.run_tests(project_dir)\n\n    async def run_tests(self, project_dir: str = \".\", pytest_args: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> AgentResult:\n        cmd = [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pytest\", \"-x\", \"-q\", \"--no-header\", \"-p\", \"no:cacheprovider\"]\n        if pytest_args:\n            cmd += pytest_args\n        try:\n            proc = await asyncio.to_thread(\n                subprocess.run, cmd, cwd=project_dir, capture_output=True,\n                text=True, timeout=900,\n            )\n            output = ((proc.stdout or \"\") + (proc.stderr or \"\"))[-4000:]\n            return AgentResult(success=proc.returncode == 0, output=output,\n                               agent_id=self.agent_id, exit_code=proc.returncode)\n        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n            return AgentResult(success=False, output=\"\", agent_id=self.agent_id,\n                               error=\"test run timed out after 900s\")\n        except FileNotFoundError as exc:\n            return AgentResult(success=False, output=\"\", agent_id=self.agent_id,\n                               error=f\"pytest not found: {exc}\")\n"
}

  "instructions": "Implement real BrowserAgent Chrome usage pattern analyzer read-only",
  "content": "\"\"\"BrowserAgent — Chrome usage pattern analyzer (read-only).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\nfrom core.agents.base import AgentResult, BaseAgent\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass BrowserSnapshot:\n    open_tabs: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    history: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    patterns: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    predictions: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    timestamp: str = \"\"\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"open_tabs\": list(self.open_tabs), \"history\": list(self.history),\n                \"patterns\": dict(self.patterns), \"predictions\": list(self.predictions),\n                \"timestamp\": self.timestamp}\n\n\nclass BrowserAgent(BaseAgent):\n    \"\"\"Analyzes browser usage patterns without controlling the browser.\"\"\"\n\n    agent_id = \"browser\"\n    keywords = [\"browse\", \"open chrome\", \"screenshot\", \"tab\", \"url in browser\"]\n    priority = 10\n    description = \"Browser usage analysis (read-only)\"\n\n    def analyze(self) -> BrowserSnapshot:\n        \"\"\"Read-only browser snapshot (empty when browser not running).\"\"\"\n        snapshot = BrowserSnapshot(timestamp=datetime.now().isoformat())\n        try:\n            from core.tools import browser_tools\n            get_tabs = getattr(browser_tools, \"list_open_tabs\", None)\n            if callable(get_tabs):\n                tabs = get_tabs() or []\n                snapshot.open_tabs = [str(t) for t in tabs][:20]\n        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — browser not available is normal\n            pass\n        snapshot.patterns = {\n            \"tab_count\": len(snapshot.open_tabs),\n            \"source\": \"browser_tools\" if snapshot.open_tabs else \"offline\",\n        }\n        return snapshot\n\n    def get_open_tabs(self) -> list[str]:\n        return list(self.analyze().open_tabs)\n\n    def get_history(self) -> list[str]:\n        return list(self.analyze().history)\n\n    def get_patterns(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return dict(self.analyze().patterns)\n\n    def get_predictions(self) -> list[str]:\n        return list(self.analyze().predictions)\n\n    async def _execute_impl(self, goal: str, context: Optional[Any] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> AgentResult:\n        snap = self.analyze()\n        lines = [f\"Browser: {len(snap.open_tabs)} open tab(s).\"]\n        lines += [f\"- {t}\" for t in snap.open_tabs[:10]]\n        return AgentResult(success=True, output=\"\\n\".join(lines), agent_id=self.agent_id)\n"
}

{

  "instructions": "Implement real ForgeAdapter and ForgeAgent with smolagents CodeAgent routed to Ollama",
  "content": "\"\"\"ForgeAdapter — codegen specialist (smolagents CodeAgent on Ollama/cloud).\n\nForge writes code. It uses smolagents' CodeAgent when available (giving the\nmodel a scratchpad to plan and execute code), falling back to plain LLM\ncode generation via core.llm_router.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport time\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\nfrom core.agents._sub_agent_base import AgentResult, SubAgent\n\nADAPTER_TIMEOUT = 300\n\n\nclass ForgeAgent(SubAgent):\n    \"\"\"Code generation & repair specialist.\"\"\"\n\n    NAME = \"FORGE\"\n    DEFAULT_MODE = \"generate\"\n    MODES = {\n        \"generate\": \"You are FORGE, an expert code generator. Output ONLY complete, runnable code with brief comments.\",\n        \"repair\": \"You are FORGE in repair mode. Fix the given code and output ONLY the corrected code.\",\n        \"refactor\": \"You are FORGE in refactor mode. Improve structure without changing behavior. Output ONLY refactored code.\",\n        \"explain\": \"You are FORGE explaining code. Give a concise line-by-line explanation.\",\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any):\n        super().__init__(**kwargs)\n        self._code_agent: Any = None\n\n    def _get_smol_agent(self) -> Any:\n        \"\"\"Lazily build a smolagents CodeAgent pointed at the local model.\"\"\"\n        if self._code_agent is not None:\n            return self._code_agent\n        try:\n            from smolagents import CodeAgent, LiteLLMModel\n\n            import os\n            model_ref = os.getenv(\"CODE_MODEL\", \"ollama/qwen2.5-coder:3b\")\n            _, _, model_id = model_ref.partition(\"/\")\n            model = LiteLLMModel(\n                model_id=f\"ollama_chat/{model_id}\",\n                api_base=os.getenv(\"OLLAMA_BASE_URL\", \"http://localhost:11434\"),\n            )\n            self._code_agent = CodeAgent(model=model, tools=[], add_base_tools=False)\n            return self._code_agent\n        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — smolagents/model unavailable\n            self._code_agent = False\n            return False\n\n    async def run(self, task: str, mode: str = \"\", lang: str = \"Python\", **kwargs: Any) -> AgentResult:\n        start = time.monotonic()\n        result = await super().run(task, mode=mode, **kwargs)\n        if not result.success:\n            return result\n\n        # Try smolagents execution for real code runs (generate mode only).\n        if (mode or self.DEFAULT_MODE) == \"generate\":\n            smol = self._get_smol_agent()\n            if smol:\n                try:\n                    output = await __import__(\"asyncio\").to_thread(smol.run, task)\n                    return AgentResult(\n                        success=True,\n                        output=str(output),\n                        agent_name=self.NAME,\n                        mode=mode or self.DEFAULT_MODE,\n                        duration_s=time.monotonic() - start,\n                        tokens_used=max(1, len(str(output)) // 4),\n                        metadata={\"engine\": \"smolagents\"},\n                    )\n                except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n                    # Fall through to plain LLM output with the error noted.\n                    result.metadata = {\"engine\": \"llm\", \"smolagents_error\": str(exc)}\n                    return result\n            result.metadata = {\"engine\": \"llm\"}\n        return result\n\n\nclass ForgeAdapter:\n    \"\"\"Adapter bridge: agent_id/priority/execute() contract for the router.\"\"\"\n\n    agent_id = \"forge\"\n    priority = 50\n    keywords = [\"codegen\", \"generate code\", \"write function\", \"implement function\",\n                \"code for\", \"refactor code\", \"write class\"]\n\n    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any):\n        self._agent = ForgeAgent(**kwargs)\n\n    @property\n    def agent(self) -> ForgeAgent:\n        return self._agent\n\n    def can_handle(self, goal: str) -> bool:\n        text = (goal or \"\").lower()\n        return any(kw.lower() in text for kw in self.keywords)\n\n    def info(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {**self._agent.info(), \"agent_id\": self.agent_id, \"priority\": self.priority}\n\n    async def run(self, task: str, mode: str = \"\", **kwargs: Any) -> Any:\n        return await self._agent.run(task, mode=mode, **kwargs)\n\n    async def execute(self, goal: str, context: Optional[Any] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:\n        from core.agents.base import AgentResult as _ToolResult\n        result = await self._agent.run(goal, mode=\"generate\", **kwargs)\n        return _ToolResult(\n            success=result.success,\n            output=result.output,\n            agent_id=self.agent_id,\n            error=result.error,\n            duration=result.duration_s,\n            metadata={\"mode\": result.mode},\n        )\n"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"AgentExecutionGraph — phase-b DAG of agent tasks with parallel execution.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\n# Step name -> execution phase (barrier: phase N waits for all of N-1).\n_STEP_PHASES: dict[str, int] = {\n    \"research\": 0,\n    \"plan\": 0,\n    \"understand\": 0,\n    \"build\": 1,\n    \"implement\": 1,\n    \"codegen\": 1,\n    \"test\": 2,\n    \"verify\": 2,\n    \"package\": 3,\n    \"deploy\": 4,\n    \"email\": 6,\n    \"notify\": 6,\n}\n\n_UNKNOWN_PHASE = 50\n\n\ndef get_phase_for_step(step: str) -> int:\n    return _STEP_PHASES.get((step or \"\").lower(), _UNKNOWN_PHASE)\n\n\nclass NodeStatus(str, Enum):\n    PENDING = \"pending\"\n    RUNNING = \"running\"\n    COMPLETED = \"completed\"\n    FAILED = \"failed\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass GraphNode:\n    node_id: str\n    agent_id: str\n    goal: str\n    phase: int = 0\n    parameters: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    status: NodeStatus = NodeStatus.PENDING\n    error: Optional[str] = None\n    output: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None\n    artifacts: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    started_at: Optional[float] = None\n    completed_at: Optional[float] = None\n\n    @property\n    def duration(self) -> Optional[float]:\n        if self.started_at is None or self.completed_at is None:\n            return None\n        return self.completed_at - self.started_at\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass AgentExecutionGraph:\n    max_parallel: int = 5\n    nodes: dict[str, GraphNode] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n    # ── structure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def add_node(self, node: GraphNode) -> GraphNode:\n        self.nodes[node.node_id] = node\n        return node\n\n    def get_node(self, node_id: str) -> Optional[GraphNode]:\n        return self.nodes.get(node_id)\n\n    # ── readiness / barriers ────────────────────────────────────────\n    def _phase_done(self, phase: int) -> bool:\n        return all(\n            n.status in (NodeStatus.COMPLETED, NodeStatus.FAILED)\n            for n in self.nodes.values() if n.phase == phase\n        )\n\n    def get_ready_nodes(self) -> list[GraphNode]:\n        \"\"\"Pending nodes whose phase barrier has opened, oldest phase first.\"\"\"\n        if not self.nodes:\n            return []\n        ready: list[GraphNode] = []\n        phases = sorted({n.phase for n in self.nodes.values()})\n        for phase in phases:\n            if not self._phase_done(phase):\n                break\n            ready = [\n                n for n in self.nodes.values()\n                if n.phase == phase and n.status == NodeStatus.PENDING\n            ]\n            if ready:\n                break\n        return ready\n\n    @property\n    def is_blocked(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"True when every earlier phase is terminal but nothing can proceed\n        because a prior phase failed entirely.\"\"\"\n        if not self.nodes or self.is_complete:\n            return False\n        phases = sorted({n.phase for n in self.nodes.values()})\n        for i, phase in enumerate(phases):\n            phase_nodes = [n for n in self.nodes.values() if n.phase == phase]\n            all_terminal = all(\n                n.status in (NodeStatus.COMPLETED, NodeStatus.FAILED)\n                for n in phase_nodes\n            )\n            if not all_terminal:\n                return False\n            if all(n.status == NodeStatus.FAILED for n in phase_nodes):\n                # This phase fully failed — later pending phases are blocked.\n                later = [n for n in self.nodes.values() if n.phase > phase]\n                return any(n.status == NodeStatus.PENDING for n in later)\n        return False\n\n    @property\n    def is_complete(self) -> bool:\n        return bool(self.nodes) and all(\n            n.status in (NodeStatus.COMPLETED, NodeStatus.FAILED)\n            for n in self.nodes.values()\n        )\n\n    # ── state transitions ───────────────────────────────────────────\n    def mark_running(self, node_id: str) -> None:\n        import time\n        node = self.nodes[node_id]\n        node.status = NodeStatus.RUNNING\n        node.started_at = time.monotonic()\n\n    def mark_completed(self, node_id: str, output: Optional[dict] = None,\n                       artifacts: Optional[dict] = None) -> None:\n        import time\n        node = self.nodes[node_id]\n        node.status = NodeStatus.COMPLETED\n        node.completed_at = time.monotonic()\n        node.output = output or {}\n        if artifacts:\n            node.artifacts.update(artifacts)\n\n    def mark_failed(self, node_id: str, error: str) -> None:\n        import time\n        node = self.nodes[node_id]\n        node.status = NodeStatus.FAILED\n        node.completed_at = time.monotonic()\n        node.error = error\n\n    # ── aggregation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def get_all_artifacts(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        merged: dict[str, Any] = {}\n        for node in self.nodes.values():\n            merged.update(node.artifacts)\n        return merged\n\n    # ── serialization ───────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"max_parallel\": self.max_parallel,\n            \"nodes\": {\n                nid: {\n                    \"node_id\": n.node_id, \"agent_id\": n.agent_id, \"goal\": n.goal,\n                    \"phase\": n.phase, \"status\": n.status.value,\n                    \"error\": n.error, \"output\": n.output,\n                    \"artifacts\": n.artifacts, \"parameters\": n.parameters,\n                    \"started_at\": n.started_at, \"completed_at\": n.completed_at,\n                }\n                for nid, n in self.nodes.items()\n            },\n        }\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> \"AgentExecutionGraph\":\n        graph = cls(max_parallel=int(data.get(\"max_parallel\", 5)))\n        for nid, nd in (data.get(\"nodes\") or {}).items():\n            graph.nodes[nid] = GraphNode(\n                node_id=nd[\"node_id\"], agent_id=nd[\"agent_id\"], goal=nd[\"goal\"],\n                phase=int(nd.get(\"phase\", 0)),\n                status=NodeStatus(nd.get(\"status\", \"pending\")),\n                error=nd.get(\"error\"), output=nd.get(\"output\"),\n                artifacts=dict(nd.get(\"artifacts\") or {}),\n                parameters=dict(nd.get(\"parameters\") or {}),\n                started_at=nd.get(\"started_at\"), completed_at=nd.get(\"completed_at\"),\n            )\n        return graph\n\n\ndef build_graph_from_tasks(tasks: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> AgentExecutionGraph:\n    \"\"\"tasks: [{'agent_id', 'goal', 'step', 'parameters'}] -> phase DAG.\"\"\"\n    graph = AgentExecutionGraph()\n    for i, t in enumerate(tasks or []):\n        step = str(t.get(\"step\", \"\"))\n        graph.add_node(GraphNode(\n            node_id=t.get(\"node_id\") or f\"node_{i}\",\n            agent_id=str(t.get(\"agent_id\", \"\")),\n            goal=str(t.get(\"goal\", \"\")),\n            phase=get_phase_for_step(step),\n            parameters=dict(t.get(\"parameters\") or {}),\n        ))\n    return graph\n"

{
  "path": "core/agents/parallel_executor.py",
  "instructions": "Implement ParallelAgentExecutor running graph nodes with phase barriers and events",
  "content": "\"\"\"ParallelAgentExecutor — executes an AgentExecutionGraph concurrently.\n\nNodes within a phase run in parallel (bounded by max_parallel); the next\nphase opens only when every node of the current phase is terminal.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\nfrom core.agents.events import AgentEvent\nfrom core.agents.graph import AgentExecutionGraph, NodeStatus\n\n\nclass ParallelAgentExecutor:\n    def __init__(self, max_parallel: int = 5, emit_events: bool = True, **kwargs: Any):\n        self.max_parallel = max(1, int(max_parallel))\n        self.emit_events = emit_events\n        self.events: list[AgentEvent] = []\n\n    def _emit(self, event_type: str, node=None, workflow_id: str = \"\", **data: Any) -> None:\n        if not self.emit_events:\n            return\n        self.events.append(AgentEvent(\n            event_type=event_type,\n            node_id=getattr(node, \"node_id\", \"\"),\n            agent_id=getattr(node, \"agent_id\", \"\"),\n            workflow_id=workflow_id,\n            data=data,\n        ))\n\n    async def execute(self, graph: AgentExecutionGraph, workflow_id: str = \"\",\n                      **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        self._emit(\"graph_started\", workflow_id=workflow_id)\n        try:\n            await self._run(graph, workflow_id)\n        finally:\n            self._emit(\"graph_completed\", workflow_id=workflow_id,\n                       complete=graph.is_complete)\n        return {\n            \"workflow_id\": workflow_id,\n            \"artifacts\": graph.get_all_artifacts(),\n            \"complete\": graph.is_complete,\n            \"blocked\": graph.is_blocked,\n        }\n\n    async def _run(self, graph: AgentExecutionGraph, workflow_id: str) -> None:\n        from core.agents.router import get_agent\n\n        while not graph.is_complete:\n            ready = graph.get_ready_nodes()\n            if not ready:\n                break  # blocked or nothing schedulable\n            for batch_start in range(0, len(ready), self.max_parallel):\n                batch = ready[batch_start:batch_start + self.max_parallel]\n                await asyncio.gather(*[\n                    self._run_node(graph, node, workflow_id, get_agent)\n                    for node in batch\n                ])\n\n    async def _run_node(self, graph: AgentExecutionGraph, node, workflow_id: str,\n                        get_agent) -> None:\n        agent = get_agent(node.agent_id)\n        if agent is None:\n            graph.mark_failed(node.node_id, f\"No agent registered for '{node.agent_id}'\")\n            self._emit(\"node_failed\", node, workflow_id, error=\"no agent\")\n            return\n        graph.mark_running(node.node_id)\n        self._emit(\"node_started\", node, workflow_id)\n        try:\n            result = await agent.execute(node.goal, **(node.parameters or {}))\n            output = result.to_dict() if hasattr(result, \"to_dict\") else {\"output\": str(result)}\n            artifacts = getattr(result, \"artifacts\", None) or {}\n            if result.success:\n                graph.mark_completed(node.node_id, output=output, artifacts=artifacts)\n                self._emit(\"node_completed\", node, workflow_id)\n            else:\n                graph.mark_failed(node.node_id, getattr(result, \"error\", \"\") or \"agent failed\")\n                self._emit(\"node_failed\", node, workflow_id)\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — isolate node failures\n            graph.mark_failed(node.node_id, f\"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}\")\n            self._emit(\"node_failed\", node, workflow_id, error=str(exc))\n"
}

{
  "path": "core/agents/executor.py",
  "instructions": "Implement make_agent_execute_fn decompose route execute enforce contract for planner",
  "content": "\"\"\"AgentDrivenExecutor — decompose → route → execute → enforce.\n\nBridges the planner state machine to the agent system: a goal is\ndecomposed into SubGoals, routed to agents, executed, and missing\nrequired steps are enforced (re-injected) before returning.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nfrom typing import Any, Awaitable, Callable\n\nExecuteFn = Callable[[str, Any], Awaitable[dict[str, Any]]]\n\n# Templates: goal keyword -> ordered required step names.\n_TEMPLATES: dict[str, list[str]] = {\n    \"android\": [\"research\", \"build\", \"test\", \"email\"],\n    \"app\": [\"research\", \"build\", \"test\", \"email\"],\n    \"apk\": [\"build\", \"test\", \"email\"],\n    \"report\": [\"research\", \"build\", \"email\"],\n}\n\n_STEP_AGENT_HINTS: dict[str, str] = {\n    \"research\": \"research\",\n    \"build\": \"build\",\n    \"test\": \"test\",\n    \"email\": \"email\",\n}\n\n\ndef _select_template(goal: str) -> list[str]:\n    text = (goal or \"\").lower()\n    for keyword, steps in _TEMPLATES.items():\n        if keyword in text:\n            return list(steps)\n    return []\n\n\nasync def _execute_step(step: str, goal: str, ctx_vars: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Route one step to its agent; fall back to the tool executor.\"\"\"\n    from core.agents.router import get_agent\n\n    agent_id = _STEP_AGENT_HINTS.get(step, \"\")\n    agent = get_agent(agent_id) if agent_id else None\n    if agent is not None:\n        ec = _make_execution_context(goal, ctx_vars)\n        result = await agent.execute(goal, ec)\n        d = result.to_dict()\n        return {\"output\": d.get(\"output\", \"\"), \"exit_code\": 0 if d.get(\"success\") else 1,\n                \"error\": d.get(\"error\", \"\"), \"_artifacts\": dict(d.get(\"artifacts\") or {})}\n\n    # Fallback: execute_tool_block (tool layer)\n    from core.tools.execution import execute_tool_block\n    tool_name, result = await execute_tool_block({\"tool\": step, \"params\": {\"goal\": goal}})\n    return result if isinstance(result, dict) else {\"output\": str(result), \"exit_code\": 0}\n\n\ndef _make_execution_context(goal: str, variables: dict[str, Any]):\n    from core.types import ExecutionContext\n    return ExecutionContext(goal=goal, variables=dict(variables or {}))\n\n\ndef make_agent_execute_fn(global_context: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> ExecuteFn:\n    \"\"\"Build the PlannerStateMachine execute_fn.\n\n    Returns async fn(goal, executor) -> {\n        artifacts, tool_calls, tool_names, error?\n    }\n    \"\"\"\n    ctx_vars = dict(global_context or {})\n\n    async def execute_fn(goal: str, executor: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        from core.planner.decomposer import GoalDecomposer\n        from core.planner.models import SubGoal\n\n        result: dict[str, Any] = {\n            \"artifacts\": {}, \"tool_calls\": [], \"tool_names\": [], \"error\": \"\",\n        }\n        if not goal or not str(goal).strip():\n            return result\n\n        # 1) Decompose\n        try:\n            tree = GoalDecomposer().decompose(str(goal))\n            subgoals = tree.flatten() if tree else []\n        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — decomposition is best-effort\n            subgoals = []\n\n        # 2) Route + 3) Execute each sub-goal\n        executed_steps: list[str] = []\n        for sg in subgoals:\n            step = getattr(sg, \"step_name\", \"\") or \"\"\n            desc = getattr(sg, \"description\", \"\") or str(goal)\n            if not step:\n                continue\n            outcome = await _execute_step(step, desc, ctx_vars)\n            executed_steps.append(step)\n            result[\"tool_calls\"].append(f\"{step}: {str(outcome.get('output', ''))[:120]}\")\n            result[\"tool_names\"].append(step)\n            arts = outcome.get(\"_artifacts\") or {}\n            if isinstance(arts, dict):\n                result[\"artifacts\"].update(arts)\n            if outcome.get(\"error\"):\n                result[\"error\"] = f\"{step}: {outcome['error']}\"\n\n        # 4) Enforce missing required steps from the matched template\n        template = _select_template(str(goal))\n        missing = [s for s in template if s not in executed_steps]\n        for step in missing:\n            desc = f\"enforced: {step} for {goal}\"\n            outcome = await _execute_step(step, desc, ctx_vars)\n            executed_steps.append(step)\n            result[\"tool_calls\"].append(f\"enforced:{step}\")\n            result[\"tool_names\"].append(step)\n            arts = outcome.get(\"_artifacts\") or {}\n            if isinstance(arts, dict):\n                result[\"artifacts\"].update(arts)\n\n        return result\n\n    return execute_fn\n\n\n__all__ = [\"make_agent_execute_fn\", \"ExecuteFn\"]\n"
}

  "instructions": "Implement SubAgentAdapter base class for adapter bridge contract",
  "content": "\"\"\"SubAgentAdapter — base for adapter bridges (SubAgent -> execute() contract).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\nADAPTER_TIMEOUT = 300\n\n\nclass SubAgentAdapter:\n    \"\"\"Bridges a SubAgent (run/mode API) into the BaseAgent contract\n    (agent_id / priority / can_handle / execute -> AgentResult).\"\"\"\n\n    agent_id = \"base\"\n    priority = 50\n    keywords: list[str] = []\n\n    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any):\n        self._kwargs = kwargs\n\n    def can_handle(self, goal: str) -> bool:\n        text = (goal or \"\").lower()\n        return any(kw.lower() in text for kw in self.keywords)\n\n    async def execute(self, goal: str, context: Optional[Any] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:\n        from core.agents.base import AgentResult\n        try:\n            result = await self._run_agent(goal, **kwargs)\n            return AgentResult(\n                success=bool(getattr(result, \"success\", False)),\n                output=str(getattr(result, \"output\", \"\")),\n                agent_id=self.agent_id,\n                error=str(getattr(result, \"error\", \"\")),\n                duration=float(getattr(result, \"duration_s\", 0.0)),\n                metadata={\"mode\": getattr(result, \"mode\", \"\")},\n            )\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — never raise out of execute()\n            return AgentResult(success=False, output=\"\", agent_id=self.agent_id,\n                               error=f\"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}\")\n\n    async def _run_agent(self, goal: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:  # pragma: no cover\n        raise NotImplementedError\n"
}

{
  "path": "core/planner/decomposer.py",
  "instructions": "Implement GoalDecomposer with feature list extraction and phase-structured decomposition",
  "content": "\"\"\"GoalDecomposer — turns a natural-language goal into a SubGoal tree.\n\nPatterns handled:\n  \"build app with X, Y and Z\"  -> one build leaf per feature (+ email if asked)\n  \"Research A, then build B\"   -> research/build/... phase leaves\n  \"Build X. Component A. B.\"   -> sentence-list component leaves\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom typing import Optional\n\n# Words that terminate a feature list (the next clause is a new step).\n_STOP_WORDS = {\"email\", \"build\", \"then\", \"research\", \"test\", \"send\", \"deploy\"}\n\n\ndef _find_features(goal: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Extract 'with X, Y and Z' / 'including X' / 'featuring X' lists.\"\"\"\n    text = goal or \"\"\n    match = re.search(\n        r\"\\b(?:with|including|featuring)\\s*:?\\s*(.+?)(?=$|\\.|;|\\bthen\\b)\",\n        text, re.IGNORECASE,\n    )\n    if not match:\n        return []\n    raw = match.group(1)\n    # Split on commas and 'and', then prune at stop-word boundaries.\n    parts = re.split(r\",|\\band\\b\", raw, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n    features: list[str] = []\n    for part in parts:\n        part = part.strip().strip(\".\")\n        words = part.split()\n        pruned: list[str] = []\n        for w in words:\n            if w.lower().rstrip(\".,!?:\") in _STOP_WORDS:\n                break\n            pruned.append(w)\n        name = \" \".join(pruned).strip()\n        if name:\n            features.append(name)\n    return features\n\n\ndef _normalize_feature_name(name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"'Admin Dashboard v2!' -> 'admin_dashboard_v2'.\"\"\"\n    cleaned = re.sub(r\"[^a-zA-Z0-9]+\", \"_\", (name or \"\").strip()).lower()\n    return cleaned.strip(\"_\")\n\n\n_SENTENCE_SPLIT = re.compile(r\"(?<=[.!;])\\s+\")\n\n\nclass GoalDecomposer:\n    \"\"\"Decomposes goals into phase-ordered SubGoal trees.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, **kwargs):\n        self._templates = {\n            \"research_build_email\": [\"research\", \"build\", \"email\"],\n            \"android_app_build\": [\"research\", \"build\", \"test\", \"email\"],\n        }\n\n    def decompose(self, goal: str) -> Optional[\"SubGoalTree\"]:\n        text = (goal or \"\").strip()\n        if not text:\n            return None\n\n        root = _SubGoalNode(id=\"root\", description=text, template_id=self._match_template(text))\n        lower = text.lower()\n\n        features = _find_features(text)\n        steps = self._phase_steps(lower)\n\n        # Feature-based build leaves\n        for feature in features:\n            norm = _normalize_feature_name(feature)\n            root.children.append(_SubGoalNode(\n                id=f\"build_{norm}\",\n                description=f\"Implement: {feature}\",\n                step_name=\"build\",\n                parameters={\"feature\": norm},\n            ))\n        # Sentence-list components (only when no explicit features found)\n        if not features and (\".\" in text or \" requirements:\" in lower):\n            components = [\n                s.strip() for s in _SENTENCE_SPLIT.split(text)\n                if s.strip() and len(s.strip()) > 3\n            ]\n            if len(components) >= 2:\n                for i, comp in enumerate(components):\n                    root.children.append(_SubGoalNode(\n                        id=f\"build_{i}\",\n                        description=f\"Implement: {comp}\",\n                        step_name=\"build\",\n                        parameters={\"feature\": _normalize_feature_name(comp)},\n                    ))\n\n        # Phase steps not already covered by feature leaves\n        covered_steps = {c.step_name for c in root.children}\n        for step in steps:\n            if step in covered_steps and step == \"build\":\n                continue  # feature leaves already cover build\n            root.children.append(_SubGoalNode(\n                id=f\"{step}_leaf\", description=text, step_name=step,\n            ))\n\n        if not root.children:\n            root.children.append(_SubGoalNode(id=\"build_leaf\", description=text,\n                                              step_name=\"build\"))\n        return SubGoalTree(root)\n\n    def _match_template(self, text: str) -> str:\n        lower = text.lower()\n        if \"email\" in lower and \"build\" in lower:\n            return \"research_build_email\"\n        if \"app\" in lower or \"android\" in lower:\n            return \"android_app_build\"\n        return \"\"\n\n    def _phase_steps(self, lower: str) -> list[str]:\n        steps: list[str] = []\n        if \"research\" in lower:\n            steps.append(\"research\")\n        if \"build\" in lower or \"app\" in lower or \"apk\" in lower:\n            steps.append(\"build\")\n        if \"test\" in lower:\n            steps.append(\"test\")\n        if \"email\" in lower or \"send\" in lower:\n            steps.append(\"email\")\n        return steps\n\n\nclass _SubGoalNode:\n    \"\"\"Internal mutable SubGoal node (avoids dataclass default sharing).\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, id: str, description: str, step_name: str = \"\",\n                 template_id: str = \"\", parameters: Optional[dict] = None):\n        self.id = id\n        self.description = description\n        self.step_name = step_name\n        self.template_id = template_id\n        self.parameters = parameters or {}\n        self.children: list[_SubGoalNode] = []\n\n    def flatten(self) -> list:\n        if not self.children:\n            from core.planner.models import SubGoal as _SG\n            return [_SG(id=self.id, description=self.description,\n                        step_name=self.step_name, template_id=self.template_id,\n                        parameters=dict(self.parameters))]\n        leaves: list = []\n        for child in self.children:\n            leaves.extend(child.flatten())\n        return leaves\n\n\nclass SubGoalTree:\n    \"\"\"Wrapper exposing .flatten() and .root over the decomposition.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, root: _SubGoalNode):\n        self.root = root\n\n    def flatten(self) -> list:\n        return self.root.flatten()\n"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"PlannerExecutor — executes plans via an injected execute_fn.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any, Awaitable, Callable\n\n\nclass PlannerExecutor:\n    \"\"\"Thin shell the state machine drives; the execute_fn does the work.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, execute_fn: Callable[[str, Any], Awaitable[dict]] | None = None, **kwargs):\n        self.execute_fn = execute_fn\n        for k, v in kwargs.items():\n            setattr(self, k, v)\n\n    async def execute(self, goal: str, **kwargs) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        if self.execute_fn is None:\n            from core.agents.executor import make_agent_execute_fn\n            self.execute_fn = make_agent_execute_fn()\n        return await self.execute_fn(goal, self)\n"

{
  "path": "core/pipeline/stages/verification.py",
  "instructions": "Implement VerificationStage deciding confirmed unconfirmed failure from context metadata",
  "content": "\"\"\"VerificationStage — decides whether an execution outcome is verified.\n\nverification_status:\n  confirmed    — success outcome AND non-empty planning_artifacts\n  unconfirmed  — success outcome but no artifacts to back it\n  failure      — the execution itself failed\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom core.pipeline.base import PipelineStage, PipelineStageResult\n\n\nclass VerificationStage(PipelineStage):\n    name = \"verification\"\n\n    async def execute(self, ctx: Any) -> PipelineStageResult:\n        md: dict[str, Any] = getattr(ctx, \"metadata\", None) or {}\n\n        outcome = str(md.get(\"planning_outcome\", md.get(\"outcome\", \"\"))).lower()\n        execution_status = str(md.get(\"execution_status\", \"\")).lower()\n        artifacts = md.get(\"planning_artifacts\") or md.get(\"artifacts\") or {}\n\n        failed = (\n            outcome in (\"failure\", \"failed\", \"error\")\n            or execution_status in (\"failed\", \"error\")\n        )\n        if failed:\n            return PipelineStageResult(\n                outcome=\"failure\",\n                metadata={\"verification_status\": \"failure\",\n                          \"reason\": \"execution reported failure\"},\n            )\n\n        succeeded = outcome in (\"success\", \"completed\", \"complete\") or \\\n            execution_status in (\"completed\", \"complete\", \"success\")\n        if not succeeded:\n            return PipelineStageResult(\n                outcome=\"skipped\",\n                metadata={\"verification_status\": \"unconfirmed\",\n                          \"reason\": f\"unknown outcome: {outcome or execution_status or 'none'}\"},\n            )\n\n        if artifacts:\n            status = \"confirmed\"\n            reason = \"success with artifacts\"\n        else:\n            status = \"unconfirmed\"\n            reason = \"success without artifacts\"\n        return PipelineStageResult(\n            outcome=\"success\" if status == \"confirmed\" else \"skipped\",\n            metadata={\"verification_status\": status, \"reason\": reason},\n        )\n"
}

Let me add NAME property to all 9 adapters via a small edit — actually simpler: in registry `names()`, check `getattr(a, 'NAME', None) or getattr(getattr(a, 'agent', None), 'NAME', None)`.

> Hmm, but cleaner design: adapters ARE named specialists; give them NAME attributes. I'll add a `NAME` property to each adapter class. But that's 9 file edits. Alternatively update names() to proxy. The property approach is more honest — the adapter represents the specialist. Let me do the names() proxy to keep the change small but also add NAME property in one shared place... Actually the adapters each define `agent_id`; I can derive NAME from agent_id.upper() in names(): adapters (priority 50) → uppercase, tool agents (priority 10) → lowercase id. That's exactly the test expectation: NEXUS, FORGE, ORACLE, PHANTOM, CIPHER, HERALD, SCRIBE, ATLAS, SENTINEL uppercase; tool agents lowercase? The test list: ["NEXUS","FORGE","ORACLE","PHANTOM","CIPHER","HERALD","SCRIBE","ATLAS","SENTINEL"] — only checks these are present, not that tool agents are lowercase.
> 
> Simplest robust: names() returns NAME attr if present, else for priority-50 agents agent_id.upper(), else agent_id.

The adapters wrap their `NAME` inside `._agent`. Fixing `names()` to surface the specialist's uppercase name:

      "newString": "    def names(self) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Registered ids sorted by priority.\n\n        Specialist adapters report their uppercase NAME (NEXUS, FORGE, ...);\n        tool agents report their lowercase agent_id.\n        \"\"\"\n        out: list[str] = []\n        for a in self.list():\n            name = getattr(a, \"NAME\", None)\n            if not name:\n                inner = getattr(a, \"agent\", None)\n                name = getattr(inner, \"NAME\", None)\n            if not name and getattr(a, \"priority\", 10) >= 50:\n                name = str(getattr(a, \"agent_id\", \"?\")).upper()\n            out.append(str(name or getattr(a, \"agent_id\", \"?\")))\n        return out",
      "allowMultiple": false
    }
  ]
}

\"arguments\": tc.get(\"arguments\", \"{}\"),\n                },\n            }\n            extra = tc.get(\"extra_content\")\n            if extra is not None:\n                entry[\"extra_content\"] = extra\n            calls.append(entry)\n        assistant[\"tool_calls\"] = calls\n        messages.append(assistant)\n\n        for i, output in enumerate(tool_outputs):\n            call_id = native_tool_calls[i].get(\"id\", f\"call_{round_num}_{i}\") \\\n                if i < len(native_tool_calls) else f\"call_{round_num}_{i}\"\n            messages.append({\n                \"role\": \"tool\",\n                \"tool_call_id\": call_id,\n                \"content\": tool_texts[i] if i < len(tool_texts) else str(output),\n            })\n    else:\n        messages.append({\"role\": \"assistant\", \"content\": text})\n        joined = \"\\n\".join(str(o) for o in tool_outputs)\n        messages.append({\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": f\"Tool may run/verify.\"\"\"\n    commands: list[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: [\"pytest\", \"python\"])\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass FileChange:\n    change_type: ChangeType\n    path: str\n    description: str = \"\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CodingResult:\n    status: CodingStatus\n    plan: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    failures: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    verification: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    evidence: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    changes_applied: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"status\": self.status.value if isinstance(self.status, CodingStatus) else self.status,\n            \"plan\": list(self.plan),\n            \"failures\": list(self.failures),\n            \"verification\": dict(self.verification),\n            \"evidence\": list(self.evidence),\n            \"changes_applied\": list(self.changes_applied),\n        }\n\n\nclass CodingAI:\n    \"\"\"Repository-aware coding capability with hard safety boundaries.\"\"\"\n\n    HIGH_RISK_TYPES = (ChangeType.DELETE,)\n\n    def __init__(self, root: str = \".\"):\n        self.root = os.path.abspath(root)\n\n    def capability_contract(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"can\": [\n                \"understand repositories\",\n                \"plan file changes\",\n                \"apply reviewed edits\",\n                \"run verification commands\",\n            ],\n            \"cannot\": [\n                \"replace the future Super-Brain\",\n                \"delete files without approval\",\n                \"execute arbitrary shell commands\",\n            ],\n        }\n\n    def execute(\n        self,\n        goal: str,\n        changes: Optional[list[FileChange]] = None,\n        constraints: Optional[CodingConstraints] = None,\n    ) -> CodingResult:\n        changes = list(changes or [])\n        constraints = constraints or CodingConstraints()\n\n        plan = [f\"{c.change_type.value}: {c.path} — {c.description}\" for c in changes]\n        failures: list[str] = high_risk)\n            )\n            return CodingResult(\n                status=CodingStatus.PARTIAL,\n                plan=plan,\n                failures=failures,\n                verification={\"status\": \"blocked\"},\n                evidence=evidence,\n            )\n\n        # No implementer wired: report structured UNKNOWN, never fake success.\n        if not verification={\"status\": \"not_run\", \"commands\": []},\n                evidence=evidence + [\"no implementer configured\"],\n            )\n\n        return CodingResult(\n            status=CodingStatus.UNKNOWN,\n            plan=plan,\n            failures=[],\n            verification={\"status\": \"not_run\", \"commands\": list(constraints.commands)},\n rm -rf variants\n    r\"\\bmkfs\\b\",\n    r\"\\bdd\\s+if=\",\n    r\"\\bformat\\b.*:\",\n    r\"\\bdel\\s+/[sq]\\b\",\n    r\"\\brd\\s+/s\\b\",\n    r\":\\(\\)\\{.*\\};:\",                      # fork bomb\n    r\"\\bshutdown\\b\",\n    r\"\\breboot\\b\",\n]\n\n_OUTPUT_LIMIT = 10_000\n\n\ndef llm_complete(prompt: str):\n    \"\"\"Module-level LLM hook (tests patch this).\"\"\"\n    from core.llm_router import complete\n    return complete(prompt)\n\n\nclass JarvisFileAgent:\n    \"\"\"File operations with confirmation gates and output limits.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any):\n        for k, v in kwargs.items():\n            setattr(self, k, v)\n\n    # ── read / write ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    async def read_file(self, path: str) -> str:\n        def _read():\n            with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as f:\n                return f.read()\n        return await asyncio.to_thread(_read)\n\n    async def write_file(self, path: str, content: str,\n                         skip_confirm: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        def _write():\n            p = Path(path)\n            existed = p.exists()\n            old = p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") if existed else \"\"\n            if existed and old == content:\n                return {\"changed\": False, \"size\": len(content)}\n            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n            p.write_text(content, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n            diff = \"\\n\".join(difflib.unified_diff(\n                old.splitlines(), content.splitlines(),\n                fromfile=\"old\", tofile=\"new\", lineterm=\"\"))[:2000] if existed else \"\"\n            result = {\"changed\": True, \"size\": len(content)}\n            if diff:\n                result[\"diff\"] = diff\n            return result\n        return await asyncio.to_thread(_write)\n\n    # ── edit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    async def edit_file(self, path: str, old: str, new: str,\n                        skip_confirm: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        def _edit():\n            p = Path(path)\n            if not p.exists():\n                return {\"error\": f\"file not found: {path}\"}\n            content = p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            if old in content:\n                updated = content.replace(old, new, 1)\n                p.write_text(updated, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n                return {\"changed\": True, \"exact_match\": True}\n            # Fuzzy match: similar block replacement\n            lines = content.splitlines()\n            old_lines = old.splitlines()\n            matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, lines, old_lines)\n            block = matcher.get_matching_blocks()\n            if block and block[0].size > 0:\n                start = block[0].a\n                end = start + len(old_lines) if start + len(old_lines) <= len(lines) else len(lines)\n                similarity = sum(b.size for b in block) / max(1, len(old_lines))\n                if similarity >= 0.6:\n                    updated_lines = lines[:start] + new.splitlines() + lines[end:]\n                    p.write_text(\"\\n\".join(updated_lines), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n                    return {\"changed\": True, \"fuzzy_match\": True,\n                            \"similarity\": round(similarity, 2)}\n            return {\"error\": \"no match found for edit\"}\n        return await asyncio.to_thread(_edit)\n\n    # ── list / tree ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    async def list_files(self, directory: str, recursive: bool = False,\n                         pattern: str = \"\") -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n        def _list():\n            p = Path(directory)\n            if not p.is_dir():\n                return []\n            glob = p.rglob(\"*\") if recursive else p.glob(\"*\")\n            out = []\n            for f in sorted(glob):\n                if not f.is_file():\n                    continue\n                rel = str(f.relative_to(p)) if recursive else f.name\n                if pattern and pattern not in f.name:\n                    continue\n                out.append({\"name\": rel, \"path\": str(f),\n                            \"size\": f.stat().st_size})\n            return out\n        return await asyncio.to_thread(_list)\n\n    async def tree_view(self, directory: str, depth: int = 3) -> str:\n        def _tree():\n            p = Path(directory)\n            if not p.is_dir():\n                return \"\"\n            lines: list[str] = []\n\n            def walk(d: Path, level: int) -> None:\n                if level > depth:\n                    return\n                for child in sorted(d.iterdir()):\n                    indent = \"  \" * level\n                    if child.is_dir():\n                        lines.append(f\"{indent}{child.name}/\")\n                        walk(child, level + 1)\n                    else:\n                        lines.append(f\"{indent}{child.name}\")\n            walk(p, 0)\n            return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n        return await asyncio.to_thread(_tree)\n\n    # ── commands ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    async def run_command(self, command: str, timeout: int = 60,\n                          cwd: str | None = None,\n                          skip_confirm: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        for pattern in _BLOCKED_PATTERNS:\n            if re.search(pattern, command, re.IGNORECASE):\n                return {\"error\": f\"blocked destructive command: {pattern}\"}\n\n        async def _run():\n            try:\n                proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_shell(\n                    command,\n                    cwd=cwd or os.getcwd(),\n                    stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,\n                    stderr=asyncio.subprocess.STDOUT,\n                )\n                try:\n                    out, _ = await asyncio.wait_for(proc.communicate(), timeout=timeout)\n                except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n                    proc.kill()\n                    return {\"returncode\": -1, \"stdout\": \"\", \"error\": f\"timed out after {timeout}s\"}\n                text = out.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") if out else \"\"\n                return {\"returncode\": proc.returncode or 0,\n                        \"stdout\": text[:_OUTPUT_LIMIT]}\n            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n                return {\"returncode\": -1, \"stdout\": \"\", \"error\": str(exc)}\n        return await _run()\n\n    # ── organize / generate ─────────────────────────────────────────\n    async def organize_folder(self, directory: str, instruction: str = \"\",\n                              skip_confirm: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        p = Path(directory)\n        if not p.is_dir():\n            return {\"error\": f\"not a directory: {directory}\"}\n        moved = 0\n        by_type: dict[str, str] = {\n            \".jpg\": \"images\", \".png\": \"images\", \".gif\": \"images\",\n            \".pdf\": \"documents\", \".docx\": \"documents\", \".txt\": \"documents\",\n            \".mp3\": \"audio\", \".mp4\": \"video\", \".zip\": \"archives\",\n        }\n        for f in list(p.iterdir()):\n            if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in by_type:\n                target = p / by_type[f.suffix.lower()]\n                target.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n                if not (target / f.name).exists():\n                    shutil.move(str(f), str(target / f.name))\n                    moved += 1\n        return {\"summary\": f\"organized {moved} file(s) by type\", \"moved\": moved}\n\n    async def generate_document(self, template: str, data: dict[str, Any],\n                                output_path: str,\n                                skip_confirm: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        # Try LLM enhancement, fall back to plain template fill.\n        content = template\n        for key, value in (data or {}).items():\n            content = content.replace(\"{{\" + key + \"}}\", str(value))\n        if \"{{\" not in content:\n            try:\n                res = llm_complete(f\"Polish this document:\\n{content}\")\n                if hasattr(res, \"is_ok\") and res.is_ok():\n                    content = res.unwrap()\n            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — LLM optional\n                pass\n        return await self.write_file(output_path, content, skip_confirm=True)\n\n\n# Module-level singleton\nfile_agent = JarvisFileAgent()\n\n__all__ = [\"JarvisFileAgent\", \"file_agent\", \"llm_complete\"]\n"
}

      import os
      import shutil
      import tempfile
      import unittest
      
      from core.coding import CodingAI, CodingConstraints, CodingStatus, FileChange, ChangeType
      
      
      class TestCodingAIContract(unittest.TestCase):
          def setUp(self):
              self._tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
              files = {
                  "src/auth.py": "def login(user):\n    return True\n",
                  "src/helpers.py": "def format_name(name):\n    return name.strip()\n",
                  "src/tests/test_auth.py": "from src.auth import login\n\ndef test_login():\n    assert login('u')\n",
              }
              for path, content in files.items():
                  full = os.path.join(self._tmp, path)
                  os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(full), exist_ok=True)
                  with open(full, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                      handle.write(content)
      
          def tearDown(self):
              shutil.rmtree(self._tmp, ignore_errors=True)
      
          def test_capability_contract_has_boundaries(self):
              ai = CodingAI(self._tmp)
              contract = ai.capability_contract()
              self.assertIn("understand repositories", contract["can"])
              self.assertIn("replace the future Super-Brain", contract["cannot"])
      
          def test_execute_high_risk_requires_approval(self):
              ai = CodingAI(self._tmp)
              result = ai.execute(
                  "Fix authentication bug",
                  changes=[FileChange(ChangeType.MODIFY, "src/auth.py", "Investigate login")],
              )
              self.assertEqual(result.status, CodingStatus.PARTIAL)
              self.assertIn("status", result.to_dict())
              self.assertTrue(result.failures)
      
          def test_execute_returns_structured_unknown_without_implementer(self):
              ai = CodingAI(self._tmp)
              result = ai.execute(
                  "Update helper",
                  constraints=CodingConstraints(commands=[]),
                  changes=[FileChange(ChangeType.MODIFY, "src/helpers.py", "Review helper")],
              )
              data = result.to_dict()
              self.assertEqual(data["status"], "unknown")
              self.assertIn("plan", data)
              self.assertIn("verification", data)
              self.assertIn("evidence", data)

So: changes touching security-sensitive files (auth, password, token, secret, crypto) are high-risk → PARTIAL + failures. Non-sensitive with no implementer → UNKNOWN.

    """RETRY outcome causes the stage to be re-invoked."""

    call_count = 0

    class _RetryStage(PipelineStage):
        @property
        def name(self) -> str:
            return "retry_stage"

        async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
            nonlocal call_count
            call_count += 1
            if call_count < 2:
                return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.RETRY, context=context)
            return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)

    p = Pipeline()
    p.add_stage(_RetryStage())
    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    assert call_count == 2
    assert result.execution_state == "pending"  # CONTINUE keeps state


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_pipeline_exhausts_retries():
    """Stage that keeps returning RETRY eventually fails."""

    class _AlwaysRetryStage(PipelineStage):
        max_retries = 2

        @property
        def name(self) -> str:
            return "always_retry"

        async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
            return StageResult(
                outcome=StageOutcome.RETRY,
                context=context,
                error="transient error",
            )

    p = Pipeline()
    p.add_stage(_AlwaysRetryStage())
    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    assert result.execution_state == "failed"
    assert result.error == "stage 'always_retry' exhausted retries: transient error"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_pipeline_retries_on_timeout():
    """Stage that times out gets retried, then fails."""

    call_count = 0

    class _TimeoutStage(PipelineStage):
        timeout = 0.01
        max_retries = 1

        @property
        def name(self) -> str:
            return "timeout_stage"

        async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
            nonlocal call_count
            call_count += 1
            await asyncio.sleep(1)  # much longer than timeout
            return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)

    p = Pipeline()
    p.add_stage(_TimeoutStage())
    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    assert call_count == 2  # initial + 1 retry
    assert result.execution_state == "failed"
    assert "timed out" in (result.error or "")


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_pipeline_retries_on_exception():
    """Stage that raises an exception gets retried, then succeeds."""

    call_count = 0

    class _FickleStage(PipelineStage):
        @property
        def name(self) -> str:
            return "fickle_stage"

        async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
            nonlocal call_count
            call_count += 1
            if call_count < 2:
                raise RuntimeError("transient boom")
            return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)

    p = Pipeline()
    p.add_stage(_FickleStage())
    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    assert call_count == 2
    assert result.execution_state == "pending"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_pipeline_exception_exhausts_retries():
    """Stage that always raises eventually fails."""

    class _AlwaysCrashStage(PipelineStage):
        max_retries = 1

        @property
        def name(self) -> str:
            return "crash_stage"

        async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
            raise RuntimeError("boom")

    p = Pipeline()
    p.add_stage(_AlwaysCrashStage())
    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    assert result.execution_state == "failed"
    assert "boom" in (result.error or "")

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_pipeline_stops_on_cancelled():
    """CANCELLED outcome from a stage stops the pipeline."""

    class _CancelStage(PipelineStage):
        @property
        def name(self) -> str:
            return "cancel_stage"

        async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
            return StageResult(
                outcome=StageOutcome.CANCELLED,
                context=context,
                error="user interrupted",
            )

    p = Pipeline()
    p.add_stage(_PassStage())
    p.add_stage(_CancelStage())
    p.add_stage(_PassStage())  # should NOT run

    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    assert result.execution_state == "cancelled"
    assert result.error == "user interrupted"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_pipeline_external_cancel():
    """Calling pipeline.cancel() mid-execution stops subsequent stages."""

    executed_stages: list[str] = []

    class _TrackStage(PipelineStage):
        def __init__(self, name: str) -> None:
            self._name = name

        @property
        def name(self) -> str:
            return self._name

        async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
            executed_stages.append(self._name)
            return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)

    p = Pipeline()
    p.add_stage(_TrackStage("first"))
    p.add_stage(_TrackStage("second"))

    # Cancel before execution
    p.cancel()

    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    assert result.execution_state == "cancelled"
    assert "first" not in executed_stages

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_hooks_fire_before_and_after():
    events: list[str] = []

    def record_before(stage: str, ctx: PipelineContext) -> None:
        events.append(f"before:{stage}")

    def record_after(stage: str, ctx: PipelineContext) -> None:
        events.append(f"after:{stage}")

    p = Pipeline()
    p.hooks.on_before("pass", record_before)
    p.hooks.on_after("pass", record_after)
    p.add_stage(_PassStage())

    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
    await p.execute(ctx)
    assert "before:pass" in events
    assert "after:pass" in events

async def test_hook_failure_does_not_crash_pipeline():
    def failing_hook(stage: str, ctx: PipelineContext) -> None:
        raise RuntimeError("hook error")

    p = Pipeline()
    p.hooks.on_before("pass", failing_hook)
    p.add_stage(_PassStage())

    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    assert result.execution_state == "pending"  # still succeeded

class _PassStage(PipelineStage):
    """Stage that always returns CONTINUE."""

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "pass"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        context.metadata["pass_ran"] = True
        return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)


class _FailStage(PipelineStage):
    """Stage that returns FAIL."""

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "fail"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        return StageResult(
            outcome=StageOutcome.FAIL,
            context=context,
            error="intentional failure",
        )


class _ShortCircuitStage(PipelineStage):
    """Stage that returns SHORT_CIRCUIT."""

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "short_circuit"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        return StageResult(
            outcome=StageOutcome.SHORT_CIRCUIT,
            context=context,
            error="intentional short-circuit",
        )


class _DeferStage(PipelineStage):
    """Stage that returns DEFER."""

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "defer"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        return StageResult(
            outcome=StageOutcome.DEFER,
            context=context,
            error="needs user input",
        )


class _MetricsStage(PipelineStage):
    """Stage that emits metrics."""

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "metrics"

        return StageResult(
            outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE,
            context=context,

async def test_classify_to_formatter_pipeline():
    """Run from receive through intent to formatter (no Execution).
    Includes all ADR-007 stages."""
    from core.pipeline.stages import (
        ContextRetrievalStage,
        ExplainabilityStage,
        KnowledgeStage,
        LearningStage,
        PlanValidatorStage,
        PolicyOptimizationStage,
        ReasoningStage,
        ReflectionStage,
    )

    p = Pipeline()
    for name, cls in (
        ("receive", ReceiveStage),
        ("intent", IntentStage),

        ("context_retrieval", ContextRetrievalStage),
        ("knowledge", KnowledgeStage),
        ("reasoning", ReasoningStage),
        ("planner", PlannerStage),
        ("plan_validator", PlanValidatorStage),
        ("capability_selection", CapabilitySelectionStage),
        ("verification", VerificationStage),
        ("epistemic", EpistemicTaggingStage),
        ("reflection", ReflectionStage),
        ("learning", LearningStage),
        ("policy_optimization", PolicyOptimizationStage),
        ("metrics", MetricsStage),
        ("explainability", ExplainabilityStage),
        ("formatter", FormatterStage),
    ):
        p.add_stage(cls())

    ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="test-1", transport="pytest", raw_input="hello world")
    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    assert result.classification is not None
    assert result.classification["mode"] in ("chat", "action", "direct", "codebase", "agent")
    assert result.retrieved_context is not None
    assert result.knowledge_result is not None
    assert result.reasoning_assessment is not None
    assert result.planner_result is not None
    assert result.reflection_result is not None
    assert result.plan is not None
    assert result.plan_validated is True
    assert result.formatted_response is not None
    assert "text" in result.formatted_response

    result = await stage.execute(ctx)
    ar = result.context.authentication_result
    assert ar is not None
    assert ar.authenticated is False
    assert ar.state.name == "ANONYMOUS"
    assert ar.reason == "no identity context"

async def test_metrics_stage_intelligence_fields(ctx):
    """MetricsStage populates intelligence metrics from ArchitectureMetrics."""
    from core.pipeline.reasoning_result import Belief, ReasoningResult
    from core.pipeline.knowledge_result import KnowledgeResult
    from core.pipeline.reflection_result import ReflectionResult
    from core.pipeline.deterministic import DeterministicServices

    services = DeterministicServices.fake()
    ctx.request_id = services.uuid4()
    ctx.reasoning_assessment = {"complexity": "simple", "confidence": 0.85}
    ctx.reasoning_result = ReasoningResult(
        reasoning_id=services.uuid4(),
        activity_id=services.uuid4(),
        complexity="simple",
        beliefs=(
            Belief(belief_id=services.uuid4(), claim="test", confidence=0.9, status="accepted"),
            Belief(belief_id=services.uuid4(), claim="test2", confidence=0.8, status="accepted"),
        ),
        evidence=(),
        contradictions=(),
        counter_hypotheses=(),
        confidence=0.85,
    )
    ctx.knowledge_result = KnowledgeResult(
        knowledge_id=services.uuid4(),
        activity_id=services.uuid4(),
        entities=("e1",),
        facts=("f1",),
        edges=(),
        node_count=2,
        edge_count=1,
    )
    ctx.reflection_result = ReflectionResult(
        reflection_id=services.uuid4(),
        activity_id=services.uuid4(),
        question="test",
        success_rating=0.8,
        overall_confidence=0.75,
        lessons=("lesson1",),
    )

    stage = MetricsStage()
    result = await stage.execute(ctx)

    metrics = result.context.metrics
    assert metrics.get("intel_beliefs") == 2
    assert metrics.get("intel_evidence") == 0
    assert metrics.get("intel_knowledge_entities") == 1
    assert metrics.get("intel_knowledge_facts") == 1
    assert metrics.get("intel_knowledge_edges") == 1
    assert metrics.get("intel_knowledge_nodes") == 2
    assert metrics.get("intel_reflection_success") == 0.8
    assert metrics.get("intel_reasoning_confidence") == 0.85
    assert metrics.get("intel_reasoning_complexity") == "simple"

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def _make_identity(
    user_id: str | None = None,
    state: AuthenticationState = AuthenticationState.ANONYMOUS,
) -> IdentityContext:
    user = UserIdentity(id=user_id) if user_id else None
    agent = AgentIdentity(id="test", type="test")
    return IdentityContext(
        user=user,
        agent=agent,
        authentication_state=state,
    )


class _IdentityCapturingStage(PipelineStage):
    """Captures identity and auth result after authentication."""

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "test_capture"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        self.captured_identity = context.identity
        self.captured_auth_result = context.authentication_result
        return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)


class _AuthTokenStage(PipelineStage):
    """Injects an auth token into metadata before authentication."""

    def __init__(self, token: str | None):
        self.token = token

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "test_seed_auth"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        if self.token is not None:
            context.metadata["auth_token"] = self.token

class TestAnonymous:
    """No identity context, no token → ANONYMOUS, not authenticated."""

    async def test_anonymous_no_identity(self):
        identity, auth_result = await _run_pipeline_with_auth(identity=None)
        assert auth_result is not None
        assert auth_result.authenticated is False
        assert auth_result.state == AuthenticationState.ANONYMOUS
        assert auth_result.principal is None
        assert auth_result.reason == "no identity context"

    async def test_anonymous_with_identity(self):
        identity = _make_identity()
        result_identity, auth_result = await _run_pipeline_with_auth(identity=identity)
        assert auth_result is not None
        assert auth_result.authenticated is False
        assert auth_result.state == AuthenticationState.ANONYMOUS
        assert result_identity is not None
        assert result_identity.authentication_state == AuthenticationState.ANONYMOUS

async def _run_pipeline_with_auth(
    identity: IdentityContext | None,
    token: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[IdentityContext | None, AuthenticationResult | None]:
    """Run pipeline with AuthenticationStage and return identity + result."""
    capture = _IdentityCapturingStage()
    p = Pipeline()
    if token is not None:
        p.add_stage(_AuthTokenStage(token))
    p.add_stage(AuthenticationStage())
    p.add_stage(capture)

    ctx = PipelineContext(
        request_id="test-auth",
        transport="test",
        raw_input="hello",
    )
    ctx.identity = identity
    if token is not None:
        ctx.metadata["auth_token"] = token

    result = await p.execute(ctx)
    return result.identity, result.authentication_result
