      """ResourceScope — tenant-scoped visibility for resources and events."""
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      from dataclasses import dataclass, field
      from enum import Enum
      from typing import Any, Optional
      
      
      class Visibility(str, Enum):
          PRIVATE = "private"
          TENANT = "tenant"
          PUBLIC = "public"
      
      
      @dataclass
      class ResourceScope:
          """Logical partition key: resources/events belong to a tenant+scope."""
          tenant_id: str = "default"
          user_id: Optional[str] = None
          visibility: Visibility = Visibility.TENANT
          metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
      
          def matches(self, other: "ResourceScope") -> bool:
              """Same-tenant match (public scopes match across tenants)."""
              if self.visibility == Visibility.PUBLIC or other.visibility == Visibility.PUBLIC:
                  return True
              return self.tenant_id == other.tenant_id
      
          def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
              return {"tenant_id": self.tenant_id, "user_id": self.user_id,
                      "visibility": self.visibility.value}

          source: str = "default"
          metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
      
      
      class TenantResolver:
          """Interface: resolve(context) -> TenantResolutionResult."""
      
          def resolve(self, context: Any) -> TenantResolutionResult:
              raise NotImplementedError
      
      
      class DefaultTenantResolver(TenantResolver):
          """Reads tenant_id from context/metadata, defaulting to 'default'."""
      
          def resolve(self, context: Any) -> TenantResolutionResult:
              tenant_id = getattr(context, "tenant_id", None)
              if not tenant_id:
                  metadata = getattr(context, "metadata", None) or {}
                  tenant_id = metadata.get("tenant_id", "default")
              return TenantResolutionResult(tenant_id=str(tenant_id), resolved=True,
                                            source="context")

class TestSchedulerTenantIsolation:
    """Scheduler queues must be tenant-partitioned."""

    def test_scheduled_activity_has_tenant_id(self):
        """ScheduledActivity has tenant_id field."""
        from core.scheduler.models import ScheduledActivity
        act = ScheduledActivity(
            activity_id="a1",
            goal="test",
            tenant_id="acme",
        )
        assert act.tenant_id == "acme"

    def test_scheduler_queue_tenant_routing(self):
        """Activities submitted to different tenants go to separate partitions."""
        from core.scheduler.queue import SchedulerQueue
        from core.activity.manager import ActivityManager
        from datetime import datetime

        queue = SchedulerQueue(activity_manager=ActivityManager())
        act_a = queue.submit(
            activity_id="act_a",
            goal="tenant A work",
            priority=1,
            tenant_id="acme",
        )
        act_b = queue.submit(
            activity_id="act_b",
            goal="tenant B work",
            priority=1,
            tenant_id="other",
        )
        assert act_a.tenant_id == "acme"
        assert act_b.tenant_id == "other"
        # Both should be in the queue
        assert len(queue.all) >= 2

    def test_system_queue(self):
        """System tenant activities go to the system queue."""
        from core.scheduler.queue import SchedulerQueue
        from core.activity.manager import ActivityManager
        from core.identity.resource_scope import SYSTEM_TENANT_ID

        queue = SchedulerQueue(activity_manager=ActivityManager())
        act = queue.submit(
            activity_id="sys_act",
            goal="system maintenance",
            priority=5,
            tenant_id=SYSTEM_TENANT_ID,
        )
        assert act.tenant_id == SYSTEM_TENANT_ID
        assert act.is_ready

class TestMetricsTenantIsolation:
    """ArchitectureMetrics must carry tenant metadata."""

    def test_architecture_metrics_has_tenant_id(self):
        """ArchitectureMetrics has tenant_id and workspace_id fields."""
        metrics = ArchitectureMetrics(
            tenant_id="acme",
            workspace_id="ws-1",
        )
        assert metrics.tenant_id == "acme"
        assert metrics.workspace_id == "ws-1"

    def test_to_dict_includes_tenant(self):
        """to_dict includes tenant_id and workspace_id."""
        metrics = ArchitectureMetrics(tenant_id="acme", workspace_id="ws-1")
        d = metrics.to_dict()
        assert d["tenant_id"] == "acme"
        assert d["workspace_id"] == "ws-1"

    def test_to_snapshot_dict_includes_tenant(self):
        """to_snapshot_dict includes tenant metadata."""
        metrics = ArchitectureMetrics(tenant_id="acme")
        d = metrics.to_snapshot_dict()
        assert d["tenant_id"] == "acme"

    def test_from_context_populates_tenant(self):
        """ArchitectureMetrics.from_context reads tenant from resource_scope."""
        ctx = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
        ctx.resource_scope = ResourceScope(tenant_id="acme")
        ctx.execution_state = "completed"
        metrics = ArchitectureMetrics.from_context(ctx)
        assert metrics.tenant_id == "acme"

    def test_same_tenant_replay(self):
        """Replay within the same tenant produces identical snapshots."""
        ctx1 = PipelineContext(request_id="r1", transport="test")
        ctx1.resource_scope = ResourceScope(tenant_id="acme")

      """Tenant-aware EventBus."""
      from __future__ import annotations
      import asyncio
      from collections import defaultdict
      from typing import Callable, Any
      from dataclasses import dataclass, field
      
      
      @dataclass
      class Event:
          event_type: str = ""
          data: Any = None
          tenant_id: str = "default"
      
      
      class EventBus:
          def __init__(self):
              self._listeners: dict[str, list[Callable]] = defaultdict(list)
      
          def subscribe(self, event_type: str, handler: Callable):
              self._listeners[event_type].append(handler)
      
          def unsubscribe(self, event_type: str, handler: Callable):
              if handler in self._listeners[event_type]:
                  self._listeners[event_type].remove(handler)
      
          async def publish(self, event_type: str, data: Any = None):
              for handler in self._listeners.get(event_type, []):
                  try:
                      res = handler(data)
                      if asyncio.iscoroutine(res):
                          await res
                  except Exception:
                      pass
      
      
      global_event_bus = EventBus()

{
  "path": "core/event_bus.py",
  "instructions": "Rewrite event_bus with Event/Subscription tenant-filtered contract",
  "content": "\"\"\"Tenant-aware EventBus.\n\nContract (tests/architecture/test_tenant_isolation.py):\n- ``Event(type, source, payload, resource_scope=...)`` frozen dataclass;\n- ``Subscription(pattern, handler, tenant_id=None)`` — tenant filter;\n- ``EventBus._subscriptions`` list; ``publish(event)`` delivers to every\n  subscription whose pattern matches ``event.type`` and whose tenant filter\n  is None or equal to the event's ``resource_scope[\"tenant_id\"]``.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport fnmatch\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Optional\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Event:\n    type: str\n    source: str = \"\"\n    payload: Any = None\n    resource_scope: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    metadata: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n    @property\n    def tenant_id(self) -> str:\n        return (self.resource_scope or {}).get(\"tenant_id\", \"default\")\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict:\n        return {\n            \"type\": self.type,\n            \"source\": self.source,\n            \"payload\": self.payload,\n            \"resource_scope\": dict(self.resource_scope),\n        }\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Subscription:\n    pattern: str\n    handler: Callable\n    tenant_id: Optional[str] = None\n\n    def matches(self, event: Event) -> bool:\n        if not fnmatch.fnmatch(event.type, self.pattern):\n            return False\n        if self.tenant_id is not None:\n            return event.tenant_id == self.tenant_id\n        return True\n\n\nclass EventBus:\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._subscriptions: list[Subscription] = []\n\n    # ── registration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def subscribe(self, pattern_or_type: str, handler: Callable,\n                  tenant_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Subscription:\n        sub = Subscription(pattern=pattern_or_type, handler=handler,\n                           tenant_id=tenant_id)\n        self._subscriptions.append(sub)\n        return sub\n\n    def unsubscribe(self, subscription: Subscription) -> None:\n        try:\n            self._subscriptions.remove(subscription)\n        except ValueError:\n            pass\n\n    # ── publishing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    async def publish(self, event: Event) -> None:\n        for sub in list(self._subscriptions):\n            if not sub.matches(event):\n                continue\n            try:\n                res = sub.handler(event)\n                if asyncio.iscoroutine(res):\n                    await res\n            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — handlers must not break the bus\n                pass\n\n    def publish_sync(self, event: Event) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Fire-and-forget publish usable from sync code.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()\n        except RuntimeError:\n            asyncio.run(self.publish(event))\n            return\n        loop.create_task(self.publish(event))\n\n\n# Module-level default bus.\nglobal_event_bus = EventBus()\n\n\n__all__ = [\"Event\", \"EventBus\", \"Subscription\", \"global_event_bus\"]\n"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"ObservationHub — publishes observations onto the tenant-aware EventBus.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\nfrom core.event_bus import EventBus, Event\n\nOBSERVATION_OBSERVED = \"OBSERVATION_OBSERVED\"\n\n\nclass ObservationHub:\n    \"\"\"Fans observations out to subscribers, preserving resource scope.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, bus: Optional[EventBus] = None) -> None:\n        self.bus = bus if bus is not None else EventBus()\n        self._observations: list[Any] = []\n\n    # ── publishing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    async def publish_observation_async(self, observation: Any) -> None:\n        self._observations.append(observation)\n        payload = observation.to_dict() if hasattr(observation, \"to_dict\") \\\n            else {\"observation\": str(observation)}\n        scope = (payload or {}).get(\"resource_scope\") or {}\n        await self.bus.publish(Event(\n            type=OBSERVATION_OBSERVED,\n            source=\"observation_hub\",\n            payload=payload,\n            resource_scope=dict(scope),\n        ))\n\n    def publish_observation(self, observation: Any) -> None:\n        try:\n            import asyncio\n            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()\n        except RuntimeError:\n            asyncio.run(self.publish_observation_async(observation))\n            return\n        loop.create_task(self.publish_observation_async(observation))\n\n    # ── introspection ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    @property\n    def observations(self) -> list:\n        return list(self._observations)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"ObservationHub\", \"OBSERVATION_OBSERVED\"]\n"
}

  "instructions": "Real ActivityManager with tenant-safe link_parent_child",
  "content": "\"\"\"ActivityManager — builds and maintains the activity graph.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nfrom core.activity.models import ActivityEdge, ActivityNode, ActivityStatus\n\n\nclass ActivityManager:\n    \"\"\"In-memory activity graph with tenant-safe parent/child linking.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.nodes: dict[str, ActivityNode] = {}\n        self.edges: list[ActivityEdge] = []\n\n    # ── node management ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def create_node(self, node: ActivityNode) -> ActivityNode:\n        self.nodes[node.node_id] = node\n        return node\n\n    def get_node(self, node_id: str) -> Optional[ActivityNode]:\n        return self.nodes.get(node_id)\n\n    def link_parent_child(self, parent_id: str, child_id: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Link two nodes, rejecting cross-tenant parent/child relations.\"\"\"\n        parent = self.nodes.get(parent_id)\n        child = self.nodes.get(child_id)\n        if parent is None or child is None:\n            raise ValueError(\"parent and child must exist before linking\")\n        p_tenant = (parent.resource_scope or {}).get(\"tenant_id\", \"default\")\n        c_tenant = (child.resource_scope or {}).get(\"tenant_id\", \"default\")\n        if p_tenant != c_tenant:\n            raise ValueError(\n                f\"cross-tenant parent/child link rejected: \"\n                f\"parent tenant {p_tenant!r} != child tenant {c_tenant!r}\")\n        child.parent_id = parent_id\n        self.edges.append(ActivityEdge(src=parent_id, dst=child_id))\n\n    def set_status(self, node_id: str, status: ActivityStatus) -> bool:\n        node = self.nodes.get(node_id)\n        if node is None:\n            return False\n        node.status = status\n        return True\n\n    def children(self, parent_id: str) -> list[ActivityNode]:\n        return [n for n in self.nodes.values() if n.parent_id == parent_id]\n\n\n__all__ = [\"ActivityManager\"]\n"
}

{
  "path": "core/scheduler/queue.py",
  "instructions": "Real SchedulerQueue with tenant partitions per isolation contract",
  "content": "\"\"\"SchedulerQueue — tenant-partitioned priority queue of scheduled activities.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport threading\nfrom collections import OrderedDict\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nfrom core.activity.manager import ActivityManager\nfrom core.scheduler.models import ActivityStatus, ScheduledActivity\n\n\nclass SchedulerQueue:\n    \"\"\"Activities wait here, partitioned by tenant, ordered by priority.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, activity_manager: Optional[ActivityManager] = None) -> None:\n        self.activity_manager = activity_manager or ActivityManager()\n        self._queues: dict[str, \"OrderedDict[str, ScheduledActivity]\"] = {}\n        self._lock = threading.Lock()\n\n    # ── submission ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def submit(self, activity_id: str, goal: str, priority: int = 1,\n               tenant_id: str = \"default\", **kwargs: object) -> ScheduledActivity:\n        act = ScheduledActivity(\n            activity_id=activity_id,\n            goal=goal,\n            priority=priority,\n            tenant_id=tenant_id,\n            status=ActivityStatus.READY,\n            **kwargs,  # type: ignore[arg-type]\n        )\n        with self._lock:\n            q = self._queues.setdefault(tenant_id, OrderedDict())\n            q[activity_id] = act\n        return act\n\n    # ── consumption ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def pop_ready(self, tenant_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[ScheduledActivity]:\n        \"\"\"Next ready activity for a tenant (or any tenant), priority first.\"\"\"\n        with self._lock:\n            tenants = [tenant_id] if tenant_id else list(self._queues.keys())\n            best: Optional[ScheduledActivity] = None\n            for t in tenants:\n                q = self._queues.get(t)\n                if not q:\n                    continue\n                for act in q.values():\n                    if act.is_ready and (best is None or act.priority > best.priority):\n                        best = act\n            if best is not None:\n                self._queues[best.tenant_id].pop(best.activity_id, None)\n            return best\n\n    # ── introspection ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    @property\n    def all(self) -> list[ScheduledActivity]:\n        with self._lock:\n            return [a for q in self._queues.values() for a in q.values()]\n\n    def tenants(self) -> list[str]:\n        with self._lock:\n            return list(self._queues.keys())\n\n    def __len__(self) -> int:\n        return len(self.all)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"SchedulerQueue\"]\n"
}

Now the real AuthManager in core/auth.py (sessions.json with expiry, is_admin users, roles):

**🛠 Write File**

```json
{
  "path": "core/auth.py",
  "instructions": "Real AuthManager with pbkdf2 users, sessions.json expiry persistence, is_admin/roles",
  "content": "\"\"\"AuthManager — credential setup, session tokens, roles.\n\nContract (tests/architecture/test_authentication.py,\ntests/architecture/test_authorization.py):\n- ``AuthManager(auth_path=...)`` persists users in auth.json and sessions in\n  ``sessions.json`` next to it (tests rewrite sessions[token][\"expiry\"]);\n- ``setup(username, password)``, ``create_session(username, password)``,\n  ``validate_token``, ``get_username_for_token``;\n- users carry ``is_admin``; expired sessions are rejected on reload.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport base64\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport os\nimport secrets\nimport time\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Optional\n\nDEFAULT_AUTH_PATH = os.path.expanduser(\"~/.jarvis/auth.json\")\n\nSESSION_TTL_SECONDS = 24 * 3600\n\n\ndef _hash_password(password: str, salt: str) -> str:\n    return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(\n        \"sha256\", password.encode(\"utf-8\"), salt.encode(\"utf-8\"), 120_000\n    ).hex()\n\n\nclass AuthManager:\n    def __init__(self, auth_path: str = DEFAULT_AUTH_PATH):\n        self.auth_path = auth_path\n        self.sessions_path = os.path.join(\n            os.path.dirname(auth_path) or \".\", \"sessions.json\")\n        self.users: Dict[str, dict] = {}\n        self._config: Dict[str, Any] = {\"users\": self.users}\n        self.sessions: Dict[str, dict] = {}\n        self._load()\n\n    # ── persistence ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def _load(self) -> None:\n        if os.path.exists(self.auth_path):\n            try:\n                with open(self.auth_path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                    data = json.load(f)\n                self._config = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {\"users\": {}}\n                self.users = self._config.setdefault(\"users\", {})\n            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — corrupt file: start clean\n                self._config = {\"users\": {}}\n                self.users = self._config[\"users\"]\n        if os.path.exists(self.sessions_path):\n            try:\n                with open(self.sessions_path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                    loaded = json.load(f)\n                if isinstance(loaded, dict):\n                    self.sessions = {\n                        tok: sess\n                        for tok, sess in loaded.items()\n                        if isinstance(sess, dict)\n                        and float(sess.get(\"expiry\", 0)) > time.time()\n                    }\n            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n                self.sessions = {}\n\n    def _save(self) -> None:\n        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.auth_path) or \".\", exist_ok=True)\n        with open(self.auth_path, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            json.dump(self._config, f, indent=2)\n\n    def _save_sessions(self) -> None:\n        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.sessions_path) or \".\", exist_ok=True)\n        with open(self.sessions_path, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            json.dump(self.sessions, f, indent=2)\n\n    # ── users ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def setup(self, username: str, password: str,\n              is_admin: bool = False) -> bool:\n        salt = secrets.token_hex(16)\n        self.users[username] = {\n            \"salt\": salt,\n            \"password_hash\": _hash_password(password, salt),\n            \"is_admin\": bool(is_admin),\n            \"roles\": [\"admin\"] if is_admin else [],\n            \"created_at\": time.time(),\n        }\n        self._save()\n        return True\n\n    def verify_password(self, username: str, password: str) -> bool:\n        user = self.users.get(username)\n        if not user:\n            return False\n        return secrets.compare_digest(\n            user.get(\"password_hash\", \"\"),\n            _hash_password(password, user.get(\"salt\", \"\")),\n        )\n\n    def is_admin(self, username: str) -> bool:\n        user = self.users.get(username) or {}\n        return bool(user.get(\"is_admin\"))\n\n    def roles(self, username: str) -> list:\n        user = self.users.get(username) or {}\n        roles = list(user.get(\"roles\", []))\n        if user.get(\"is_admin\") and \"admin\" not in roles:\n            roles.append(\"admin\")\n        return roles\n\n    # ── sessions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def create_session(self, username: str, password: str,\n                       ttl_seconds: int = SESSION_TTL_SECONDS) -> Optional[str]:\n        if not self.verify_password(username, password):\n            return None\n        token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode().rstrip(\"=\")\n        self.sessions[token] = {\n            \"username\": username,\n            \"created\": time.time(),\n            \"expiry\": time.time() + ttl_seconds,\n        }\n        self._save_sessions()\n        return token\n\n    def validate_token(self, token: str) -> bool:\n        return self.get_username_for_token(token) is not None\n\n    def get_username_for_token(self, token: str) -> Optional[str]:\n        sess = self.sessions.get(token)\n        if not sess:\n            return None\n        if float(sess.get(\"expiry\", 0)) <= time.time():\n            del self.sessions[token]\n            self._save_sessions()\n            return None\n        return sess.get(\"username\")\n\n    def revoke(self, token: str) -> bool:\n        if token in self.sessions:\n            del self.sessions[token]\n            self._save_sessions()\n            return True\n        return False\n\n\n_auth_manager: Optional[AuthManager] = None\n\n\ndef get_auth_manager() -> AuthManager:\n    global _auth_manager\n    if _auth_manager is None:\n        _auth_manager = AuthManager()\n    return _auth_manager\n\n\ndef init_firebase():  # pragma: no cover — legacy hook kept for callers\n    return None\n"
}

class TestOrchestrator:
    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execute_single_step(self):
        planner = OrchestrationPlanner()
        plan = planner.plan("Write a function")

        orchestrator = Orchestrator()
        result = await orchestrator.execute(plan)
        assert result.overall_success is True
        assert len(result.step_results) >= 1

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execute_failing_step(self):
        """A failing step should trigger dynamic replanning and still succeed."""
        fail_provider = _make_provider("fail_test", success=False)
        from core.providers.registry import provider_registry
        provider_registry.register(fail_provider, priority=10)

        planner = OrchestrationPlanner()
        plan = planner.plan("Write a function")
        for s in plan.steps:
            s.provider_id = "fail_test"

        orchestrator = Orchestrator()
        result = await orchestrator.execute(plan)
        # Replanning falls back to forge, which succeeds
        assert result.overall_success is True
        assert result.avg_confidence < 1.0  # Replanning reduces confidence

        provider_registry.unregister("fail_test")

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execute_sequential_steps(self):
        planner = OrchestrationPlanner()
        plan = planner.plan("Write and review code")
        assert plan.total_steps >= 2

        # Verify dependencies create sequential ordering
        for step in plan.steps:
            if step.chain_type == ChainType.VERIFY:
                assert len(step.dependencies) > 0

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execute_parallel_steps(self):
        planner = OrchestrationPlanner()
        plan = planner.plan("Full stack app")
        parallel = [s for s in plan.steps if s.chain_type == ChainType.PARALLEL]
        assert len(parallel) >= 1  # documentation and testing should be parallel

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execution_records_memory(self):
        from core.providers.memory import provider_memory
        provider_memory._records.clear()

        planner = OrchestrationPlanner()
        plan = planner.plan("Write a function")

        orchestrator = Orchestrator()
        result = await orchestrator.execute(plan)
        assert result.overall_success is True

        # Provider memory should have been updated
        for s in plan.steps:
            record = provider_memory.get_record(s.provider_id)
            if record:
                assert record.total_executions >= 1

> The orchestration tests (tests/unit/test_orchestration.py) use:
> - `core.providers.registry.provider_registry` — module-level singleton ProviderRegistry
> - `core.providers.memory.provider_memory` — with `_records` dict, `.clear()` (dict.clear), `get_record(provider_id)` returning record with `total_executions`
> - Also `core.providers.orchestration.*` (OrchestrationPlanner, Orchestrator, ChainType...) — another module set.
> 
> So `provider_registry` needs `get(pid)` (by provider_id, not capability) — my ProviderRegistry.get does that. Need a module-level `provider_registry = ProviderRegistry()`.
> 
> `provider_memory`: ProviderMemory with `_records` dict keyed by provider_id, get_record(pid) → EvidenceRecord(total_executions=...). Orchestration code records executions into memory.
> 
> Given the chain of dependencies (orchestration planner/orchestrator stubs), test_orchestration.py is another suite. Priority per user: agents + pipeline + providers. The current failing file is trace_validation — needs providers __init__ clean.

I'll implement a real minimal ProviderMemory/EvidenceRecord and ProviderBudgetManager in memory.py/budget.py, plus module-level provider_registry singleton in registry.py. field\nfrom typing import Optional\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass EvidenceRecord:\n    provider_id: str\n    total_executions: int = 0\n    successful_executions: int = 0\n    failed_executions: int = 0\n    last_error: str = \"\"\n    last_duration_ms: float = 0.0\n    last_execution_ts: float = 0.0\n    total_duration_ms: float = 0.0\n    history: list = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    @property\n    def success_rate(self) -> float:\n        if self.total_executions == 0:\n            return 0.0\n        return self.successful_executions / self.total_executions\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict:\n        return {\n            \"provider_id\": self.provider_id,\n            \"total_executions\": self.total_executions,\n            \"successful_executions\": self.successful_executions,\n            \"failed_executions\": self.failed_executions,\n            \"success_rate\": self.success_rate,\n            \"last_error\": self.last_error,\n            \"last_duration_ms\": self.last_duration_ms,\n        }\n\n\nclass ProviderMemory:\n    \"\"\"Thread-safe store of per-provider execution evidence.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._records: dict[str, EvidenceRecord] = {}\n        self._lock = threading.Lock()\n\n    def get_record(self, provider_id: str) -> Optional[EvidenceRecord]:\n        with self._lock:\n            return self._records.get(provider_id)\n\n    def record(self, provider_id: str, success: bool,\n               duration_ms: float = 0.0, error: str = \"\") -> EvidenceRecord:\n        with self._lock:\n            rec = self._records.get(provider_id)\n            if rec is None:\n                rec = EvidenceRecord(provider_id=provider_id)\n                self._records[provider_id] = rec\n            rec.total_executions += 1\n            if success:\n                rec.successful_executions += 1\n            else:\n                rec.failed_executions += 1\n                rec.last_error = error\n            rec.last_duration_ms = duration_ms\n            rec.total_duration_ms += duration_ms\n            rec.last_execution_ts = time.time()\n            rec.history.append({\n                \"ts\": rec.last_execution_ts, \"success\": success,\n                \"duration_ms\": duration_ms, \"error\": error,\n            })\n            if len(rec.history) > 200:\n                del rec.history[:-200]\n            return rec\n\n    def all_records(self) -> list:\n        with self._lock:\n            return list(self._records.values())\n\n    def clear(self) -> None:\n        with self._lock:\n            self._records.clear()\n\n\nprovider_memory = ProviderMemory()\n\n\n__all__ = [\"EvidenceRecord\", \"ProviderMemory\", \"provider_memory\"]\n"

class ContextRetrievalStage(PipelineStage):
    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "context_retrieval"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        context.retrieved_context = {
            "items": [], "transport": context.transport,
            "request_id": context.request_id,
        }
        return _ok(context)


class KnowledgeStage(PipelineStage):
    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "knowledge"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        from core.pipeline.knowledge_result import KnowledgeResult
        context.knowledge_result = KnowledgeResult()
        return _ok(context)


class ReasoningStage(PipelineStage):
    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "reasoning"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        text = context.raw_input or ""
        complexity = "simple" if len(text) < 120 else "complex"
        context.reasoning_assessment = {
            "complexity": complexity, "confidence": 0.7,
        }
        return _ok(context)


class PlannerStage(PipelineStage):
    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "planner"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        context.plan = [{"step": "respond", "description": context.raw_input}]
        context.planner_result = {"strategy": "single_step", "steps": 1}
        return _ok(context)


class PlanValidatorStage(PipelineStage):
    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "plan_validator"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        context.plan_validated = bool(context.plan)
        return _ok(context)


class ActivityStage(PipelineStage):
    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "activity"

    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
        context.activity_id = context.request_id
        context.trace_id = context.trace_id or context.request_id
        return _ok(context)


class CapabilitySelectionStage(PipelineStage):

async def _run_knowledge(ctx: PipelineContext) -> PipelineContext:
    """Run the KnowledgeStage and return the updated context."""
    from core.pipeline.stages.knowledge import KnowledgeStage

    stage = KnowledgeStage()
    result = await stage.execute(ctx)
    assert result.context is not None
    return result.context


async def _run_knowledge_twice(
    raw_input: str,
) -> tuple[PipelineContext, PipelineContext]:
    a = _make_context(DeterministicServices.fake(), raw_input)
    b = _make_context(DeterministicServices.fake(), raw_input)

    ctx_a = await _run_knowledge(a)
    ctx_b = await _run_knowledge(b)

    return ctx_a, ctx_b

async def _run_reflection(ctx: PipelineContext) -> PipelineContext:
    """Run the ReflectionStage and return the updated context."""
    from core.pipeline.stages.reflection import ReflectionStage

    stage = ReflectionStage()
    result = await stage.execute(ctx)
    assert result.context is not None
    return result.context


def _make_reflection_context(

) -> PipelineContext:

        transport="test",
        raw_input=raw_input,
        classification={"mode": "chat", "confidence": 0.8, "sub_type": ""},
        services=services,

    raw_act = services.uuid4()
    act_hex = raw_act[:12] if isinstance(raw_act, str) else raw_act.hex[:12]
    ctx.activity_id = f"act_{act_hex}"
    ctx.plan = {"goal": raw_input, "steps": [{"intent": "respond", "objective": raw_input, "constraints": {}}]}

    if with_reasoning:
        from core.pipeline.reasoning_result import ReasoningResult, Belief

        raw_rsn = services.uuid4()
        rsn_hex = raw_rsn[:12] if isinstance(raw_rsn, str) else raw_rsn.hex[:12]
        raw_bid = services.uuid4()
        bid_hex = raw_bid[:16] if isinstance(raw_bid, str) else raw_bid.hex[:16]
        ctx.reasoning_result = ReasoningResult(
                reasoning_id=f"rsn_{rsn_hex}",

async def _run_reflection_twice(
    raw_input: str,
) -> tuple[PipelineContext, PipelineContext]:
    a = _make_reflection_context(DeterministicServices.fake(), raw_input)
    b = _make_reflection_context(DeterministicServices.fake(), raw_input)

    ctx_a = await _run_reflection(a)
    ctx_b = await _run_reflection(b)

    return ctx_a, ctx_b


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_reflection_result_is_deterministic():
    """Two runs with same deterministic services produce identical
    reflection_result (reflection_id, success_rating, lessons, patterns)."""
    ctx_a, ctx_b = await _run_reflection_twice("what is the weather?")

    assert ctx_a.reflection_result is not None
    assert ctx_b.reflection_result is not None

    rf_a = ctx_a.reflection_result
    rf_b = ctx_b.reflection_result

    # reflection_id is non-deterministic (uses uuid.uuid4() inside core/research/)
    # but semantic content must match
    assert rf_a.success_rating == rf_b.success_rating
    assert rf_a.overall_confidence == rf_b.overall_confidence
    assert rf_a.lessons == rf_b.lessons
    assert rf_a.patterns == rf_b.patterns
    assert rf_a.total_facts_collected == rf_b.total_facts_collected

Verifies that the Reasoning stage produces identical artifacts under
deterministic services, satisfying Phase 7's replay requirement.

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from core.pipeline.context import PipelineContext
from core.pipeline.deterministic import DeterministicServices
from core.pipeline.stages.reasoning import ReasoningStage
# ── Fingerprint helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────


def _belief_fingerprint(beliefs: tuple) -> str:
    """Deterministic hash of belief semantic content (not IDs)."""
    parts = []
    for b in beliefs:
        parts.append(f"{b.claim}::{b.confidence}::{b.status}")
    return "|".join(parts)


def _evidence_fingerprint(evidence: tuple) -> str:
    """Deterministic hash of evidence semantic content."""
    parts = []
    for e in evidence:
        parts.append(f"{e.direction}::{e.weight}")
    return "|".join(parts)


def _contradiction_fingerprint(contradictions: tuple) -> str:
    """Deterministic hash of contradiction entities and counts."""
    parts = []
    for c in contradictions:
        parts.append(f"{c.entity}::{len(c.facts)}")
    return "|".join(parts)


def _counter_hypothesis_fingerprint(counter_hypotheses: tuple) -> str:
    """Deterministic hash of counter-hypothesis semantic content."""
    parts = []
    for ch in counter_hypotheses:
        parts.append(f"{ch.counter_claim[:60]}")
    return "|".join(parts)

{
  "path": "core/pipeline/stages/memory.py",
  "instructions": "Real MemoryStage with verification gate and classification per contract",
  "content": "\"\"\"MemoryStage — decides what to persist from this request (Rule 2/3 owner).\n\nDecisions:\n  verification failed            -> IGNORE\n  empty execution output         -> IGNORE\n  otherwise                      -> STORE with a classified store_type:\n    preference / project / fact / conversation (keyword classification).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom core.pipeline.base import PipelineStage, StageOutcome, StageResult\nfrom core.pipeline.pipeline import PipelineContext\nfrom core.pipeline.store_decision import StoreAction, StoreDecision\n\n\n_PREFERENCE_RE = re.compile(\n    r\"\\b(my favorite|i prefer|i like|i love|i hate|my preferred|\"\n    r\"favorite|favourite)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\n_PROJECT_RE = re.compile(\n    r\"\\b(i am working on|working on a|my project|the project|\"\n    r\"new project|our project|repo|repository)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\n_FACT_RE = re.compile(\n    r\"\\b(remember that|remember this|note that|keep in mind|\"\n    r\"the fact that|fact:)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\n\nclass MemoryStage(PipelineStage):\n    @property\n    def name(self) -> str:\n        return \"memory\"\n\n    def _classify(self, ctx: PipelineContext) -> str:\n        raw = str(getattr(ctx, \"raw_input\", \"\") or \"\")\n        if _PREFERENCE_RE.search(raw):\n            return \"preference\"\n        if _PROJECT_RE.search(raw):\n            return \"project\"\n        if _FACT_RE.search(raw):\n            return \"fact\"\n        return \"conversation\"\n\n    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:\n        # 1) Never store unverified output.\n        verification = context.verification_result or {}\n        if isinstance(verification, dict) and verification.get(\"passed\") is False:\n            context.store_decision = StoreDecision(\n                action=StoreAction.IGNORE, reason=\"verification failed\")\n            context.memory_refs = []\n            return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)\n\n        # 2) Nothing to store when execution produced no text.\n        execution = context.execution_result or {}\n        text = execution.get(\"text\", \"\") if isinstance(execution, dict) \\\n            else str(execution or \"\")\n        if not str(text).strip() and not str(getattr(context, \"raw_input\", \"\")).strip():\n            context.store_decision = StoreDecision(\n                action=StoreAction.IGNORE, reason=\"no output\")\n            context.memory_refs = []\n            return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)\n\n        # 3) Classify and record the decision.  Actual persistence goes\n        # through the memory facade (Rule 2: writes confined to this stage).\n        store_type = self._classify(context)\n        user_id = getattr(context, \"user_id\", None) or \"\"\n        context.store_decision = StoreDecision(\n            action=StoreAction.STORE, store_type=store_type,\n            reason=f\"classified as {store_type}\", confidence=0.8,\n            payload={\"text\": text[:2000], \"user_id\": user_id},\n        )\n        context.memory_refs = []\n        return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"MemoryStage\"]\n"
}

core.pipeline.stages.verification.base import Verdict, Verifier\n\n\n_BLOCKED_PATTERNS = (\n    re.compile(r\"ignore\\s+(all\\s+)?previous\\s+instructions\", re.IGNORECASE),\n    re.compile(r\"disregard\\s+(all\\s+)?(prior|previous)\\s+instructions\", re.IGNORECASE),\n    re.compile(r\"reveal\\s+(your\\s+)?(system\\s+)?prompt\", re.IGNORECASE),\n)\n\n\nclass SafetyVerifier(Verifier):\n    \"\"\"Blocks prompt-injection / instruction-override output.\"\"\"\n\n    @property\n    def name(self) -> str:\n        return \"safety\"\n\n    async def verify(self, ctx: Any) -> Verdict:\n        result = getattr(ctx, \"execution_result\", None)\n        if result is None:\n            return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"PASS\")\n        text = \"\"\n        if isinstance(result, dict):\n            text = str(result.get(\"text\", \"\"))\n        elif isinstance(result, str):\n            text = result\n        for pattern in _BLOCKED_PATTERNS:\n            if pattern.search(text):\n                return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"FAIL\",\n                               message=f\"blocked pattern matched: {pattern.pattern!r}\")\n        return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"PASS\")\n\n\nclass SchemaVerifier(Verifier):\n    \"\"\"Execution output must be a dict containing a text field.\"\"\"\n\n    @property\n    def name(self) -> str:\n        return \"schema\"\n\n    async def verify(self, ctx: Any) -> Verdict:\n        result = getattr(ctx, \"execution_result\", None)\n        if result is None:\n            return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"PASS\")\n        if not isinstance(result, dict):\n            return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"FAIL\",\n                           message=f\"execution_result is {type(result).__name__}, \"\n                                   f\"expected dict\")\n        if \"text\" not in result:\n            return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"WARNING\",\n                           message=\"execution_result missing 'text' field\")\n        return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"PASS\")\n\n\nclass ConfidenceVerifier(Verifier):\n    \"\"\"Warns when the epistemic confidence is low.\"\"\"\n\n    @property\n    def name(self) -> str:\n        return \"confidence\"\n\n    async def verify(self, ctx: Any) -> Verdict:\n        tags = getattr(ctx, \"epistemic_tags\", None) or {}\n        confidence = tags.get(\"confidence\") if isinstance(tags, dict) else None\n        if confidence is None:\n            return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"PASS\")\n        if float(confidence) < 0.3:\n            return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"WARNING\",\n                           message=f\"low confidence: {confidence}\")\n        return Verdict(verifier_name=self.name, outcome=\"PASS\")\n\n\n__all__ = [\"SafetyVerifier\", \"SchemaVerifier\", \"ConfidenceVerifier\"]\n"
}

{
  "path": "core/pipeline/stages/verification/stage.py",
  "instructions": "VerificationStage running the verifier chain, writing verification_result to context",
  "content": "\"\"\"VerificationStage — runs the verifier chain over the execution result.\n\nOutcome:\n  any FAIL        -> StageOutcome.FAIL, verification_result.passed = False\n  otherwise       -> StageOutcome.CONTINUE, verification_result.passed = True\nverification_result = {\"passed\": bool, \"verdicts\": [{\"verifier\",\"outcome\",\n\"message\"}...]}\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any, List\n\nfrom core.pipeline.base import PipelineStage, StageOutcome, StageResult\nfrom core.pipeline.pipeline import PipelineContext\nfrom core.pipeline.stages.verification.base import Verdict, Verifier\nfrom core.pipeline.stages.verification.verifiers import (\n    ConfidenceVerifier,\n    SafetyVerifier,\n    SchemaVerifier,\n)\n\n\nclass VerificationStage(PipelineStage):\n    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None:\n        self._verifiers: List[Verifier] = [\n            SafetyVerifier(), SchemaVerifier(), ConfidenceVerifier(),\n        ]\n\n    @property\n    def name(self) -> str:\n        return \"verification\"\n\n    # ── verifier chain management ────────────────────────────────────\n    def add_verifier(self, verifier: Verifier) -> None:\n        self._verifiers.append(verifier)\n\n    def clear_verifiers(self) -> None:\n        self._verifiers = []\n\n    @property\n    def verifiers(self) -> List[Verifier]:\n        return list(self._verifiers)\n\n    # ── execution ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:\n        verdicts: List[Verdict] = []\n        for verifier in self._verifiers:\n            try:\n                verdicts.append(await verifier.verify(context))\n            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — verifier bugs must not crash\n                verdicts.append(Verdict(verifier_name=getattr(verifier, \"name\",\n                                                          type(verifier).__name__),\n                                        outcome=\"WARNING\",\n                                        message=f\"verifier raised: {exc}\"))\n\n        failed = any(v.outcome == \"FAIL\" for v in verdicts)\n        context.verification_result = {\n            \"passed\": not failed,\n            \"verdicts\": [\n                {\"verifier\": v.verifier_name, \"outcome\": v.outcome,\n                 \"message\": v.message}\n                for v in verdicts\n            ],\n        }\n        return StageResult(\n            outcome=StageOutcome.FAIL if failed else StageOutcome.CONTINUE,\n            context=context,\n        )\n\n\n__all__ = [\"VerificationStage\", \"Verdict\", \"Verifier\",\n           \"SafetyVerifier\", \"SchemaVerifier\", \"ConfidenceVerifier\"]\n"
}

> _Reasoning_
> Now the integration test contract: `ctx.metadata = {planning_outcome..., planning_artifacts}` and `result.metadata.get("verification_status")`. The VerificationStage in the verification package doesn't set that. I need the stage to ALSO handle the metadata-style contract. Let me extend the stage's execute to handle both:
> 
> After running verifiers, ALSO check the metadata contract:
> - md = context.metadata
> - planning_outcome/execution_status → failure → metadata["verification_status"]="failure"
> - success + artifacts → "confirmed"
> - success no artifacts → "unconfirmed"
> 
> And set result.metadata = {"verification_status": status}. Both contracts coexist: the metadata path is the "planning verification" flavor, the verifier chain is the "output verification" flavor. For the integration tests, ctx.execution_result is None (bare PipelineContext with only metadata), so verifiers pass (None → PASS), and then the metadata logic determines verification_status and possibly outcome:
> - failure → outcome=FAIL
> - confirmed → CONTINUE
> - unconfirmed → skipped → CONTINUE (outcome stays CONTINUE? "skipped" — in their test they only check result.metadata verification_status, outcome can be CONTINUE)
> 
> Set result.metadata = {"verification_status": status, "reason": reason}.

The integration tests also need the metadata-based contract on the same stage. Merging both flavors:

noqa: BLE001 — verifier bugs must not crash\n                verdicts.append(Verdict(verifier_name=getattr(verifier, \"name\",\n                                                          type(verifier).__name__),\n                                        outcome=\"WARNING\",\n                                        message=f\"verifier raised: {exc}\"))\n\n        failed = any(v.outcome == \"FAIL\" for v in verdicts)\n        context.verification_result = {\n            \"passed\": not failed,\n            \"verdicts\": [\n                {\"verifier\": v.verifier_name, \"outcome\": v.outcome,\n                 \"message\": v.message}\n                for v in verdicts\n            ],\n        }\n\n        result = StageResult(\n            outcome=StageOutcome.FAIL if failed else StageOutcome.CONTINUE,\n            context=context,\n        )\n\n        # Planning-artifact flavor (integration contract): when the context\n        # carries planning metadata, derive a verification_status from the\n        # execution outcome and expose it on result.metadata.\n        md = getattr(context, \"metadata\", None) or {}\n        if md:\n            outcome = str(md.get(\"planning_outcome\", md.get(\"outcome\", \"\"))).lower()\n            execution_status = str(md.get(\"execution_status\", \"\")).lower()\n            artifacts = md.get(\"planning_artifacts\") or md.get(\"artifacts\") or {}\n\n            if outcome in (\"failure\", \"failed\", \"error\") or \\\n                    execution_status in (\"failed\", \"error\"):\n                status, reason = \"failure\", \"execution reported failure\"\n            elif outcome in (\"success\", \"completed\", \"complete\") or \\\n                    execution_status in (\"completed\", \"complete\", \"success\"):\n                if artifacts:\n                    status, reason = \"confirmed\", \"success with artifacts\"\n                else:\n                    status, reason = \"unconfirmed\", \"success without artifacts\"\n            else:\n                status, reason = \"unconfirmed\", \\\n                    f\"unknown outcome: {outcome or execution_status or 'none'}\"\n            result.metadata = {\"verification_status\": status, \"reason\": reason}\n\n        return result",

  "content": "\"\"\"ReflectionStage — Rule 52 owner of ReflectionResult construction.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom core.pipeline.base import PipelineStage, StageOutcome, StageResult\nfrom core.pipeline.pipeline import PipelineContext\nfrom core.pipeline.reflection_result import ReflectionResult\n\n\nclass ReflectionStage(PipelineStage):\n    @property\n    def name(self) -> str:\n        return \"reflection\"\n\n    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:\n        services = getattr(context, \"services\", None)\n        import uuid as _uuid\n\n        reflection_id = f\"ref_{(services.uuid4() if services is not None and hasattr(services, 'uuid4') else _uuid.uuid4().hex)[:24]}\"\n        rr = getattr(context, \"reasoning_result\", None)\n        beliefs = tuple(getattr(rr, \"beliefs\", ()) or ()) if rr is not None else ()\n        confidence = float(getattr(rr, \"confidence\", 0.0) or 0.0) if rr is not None else 0.0\n\n        # Success rating: derive deterministically from the plan + beliefs.\n        plan = getattr(context, \"plan\", None)\n        steps = plan.get(\"steps\", []) if isinstance(plan, dict) else []\n        success_rating = 0.0\n        if steps:\n            success_rating = min(1.0, 0.5 + 0.1 * len(steps))\n        if beliefs:\n            success_rating = min(1.0, success_rating + 0.2)\n        if not context.raw_input:\n            success_rating = 0.0\n\n        context.reflection_result = ReflectionResult(\n            reflection_id=reflection_id,\n            activity_id=getattr(context, \"activity_id\", \"\") or \"\",\n            question=str(getattr(context, \"raw_input\", \"\") or \"\"),\n            success_rating=success_rating,\n            overall_confidence=confidence,\n            lessons=(\"review plan outcomes\",) if steps else (),\n            metadata={},\n        )\n        return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"ReflectionStage\"]\n"
}

ReasoningResult\n\n_SIMPLE_MAX_CHARS = 120\n_MULTI_STEP_RE = re.compile(\n    r\"\\b(research|compare|analyz|design|plan|implement|investigate|\"\n    r\"evaluate|multi.?step)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\n\nclass ReasonerStage(PipelineStage):\n    @property\n    def name(self) -> str:\n        return \"reasoning\"\n\n    def assess_complexity(self, text: str) -> str:\n        if not text:\n            return \"simple\"\n        if len(text) > _SIMPLE_MAX_CHARS or _MULTI_STEP_RE.search(text):\n            return \"multi_step\"\n        return \"simple\"\n\n    async def getattr(context, \"services\", None)\n        import uuid as _uuid\n\n        rid_raw = services.uuid4() if services is not None and hasattr(services, \"uuid4\") \\\n            else _uuid.uuid4().hex\n        rid = f\"rsn_{rid_raw[:24]}\"\n\n        confidence = 0.9 if complexity == \"simple\" else 0.7\n        belief = Belief(belief_id=f\"{rid[:16]}_b1\",\n                        claim=text[:120] or \"empty request\",\n                        confidence=confidence, status=\"accepted\")\n        context.reasoning_result = ReasoningResult(\n            reasoning_id=rid,\n            activity_id=getattr(context, \"activity_id\", \"\") or \"\",\n            complexity=complexity,\n            beliefs=(belief,),\n            evidence=(),\n            contradictions=(),\n            counter_hypotheses=(),\n            confidence=confidence,\n        )\n        context.reasoning_assessment = {\n            \"complexity\": complexity, \"confidence\": confidence,\n        }\n        return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"ReasonerStage\"]\n"

research required -> \"research\"\n  coding required   -> \"code\"\n  fallback          -> \"balanced\" (when only direct exists)\nRanking: highest estimated success first; pairwise comparisons recorded.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport uuid as _uuid\n\nfrom core.pipeline.base import PipelineStage, StageOutcome, StageResult\nfrom core.pipeline.pipeline import PipelineContext\nfrom core.pipeline.planner_result import (\n    PlannerResult,\n    PlanRanking,\n    PlanningStrategy,\n    StrategyComparison,\n)\n\n\ndef _strategy_defs(requirements: list) -> list[tuple]:\n    defs = [(\"direct\", 0.9, 1)]\n    if any(\"research\" in r for r in requirements):\n        defs.append((\"research\", 0.8, 3))\n    if any(\"coding\" in r for r in requirements):\n        defs.append((\"code\", 0.75, 4))\n    if len(defs) == 1:\n        defs.append((\"balanced\", 0.7, 2))\n    return defs\n\n\nclass PlannerStage(PipelineStage):\n    @property\n    def name(self) -> str:\n        return \"planner\"\n\n    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:\n        services = getattr(context, \"services\", None)\n        plan_id = services.uuid4() if services is not None and hasattr(services, \"uuid4\") \\\n            else _uuid.uuid4().hex\n\n        assessment = getattr(context, \"reasoning_assessment\", None) or {}\n        requirements = list(assessment.get(\"requirements\", [])\n                            if isinstance(assessment, dict) else [])\n\n        strategies = [\n            PlanningStrategy(name=n, confidence=c, estimated_steps=s,\n                             requirements=tuple(requirements))\n            for n, c, s in _strategy_defs(requirements)\n        ]\n        strategies.sort(key=lambda s: (-s.confidence, s.name))\n        selected = strategies[0]\n\n        comparisons = tuple(\n            StrategyComparison(left=a.name, right=b.name, winner=a.name,\n                               rationale=f\"{a.name} confidence {a.confidence} >= \"\n                                         f\"{b.name} confidence {b.confidence}\")\n            for i, a in enumerate(strategies)\n            for b in strategies[i + 1:]\n        )\n\n        ranking = PlanRanking(\n            strategies=tuple(strategies),\n            selected_id=selected.name,\n            selection_rationale=f\"selected {selected.name} \"\n                                f\"(confidence={selected.confidence})\",\n            comparisons=comparisons,\n        )\n        context.planner_result = PlannerResult(\n            plan_id=plan_id,\n            activity_id=getattr(context, \"activity_id\", \"\") or \"\",\n            total_candidates=len(strategies),\n            ranking=ranking,\n        )\n\n        # Backward-compat plan (dict form used by the ExecutionStage).\n        goal = str(getattr(context, \"raw_input\", \"\") or \"\")\n        context.plan = {\n            \"goal\": goal,\n            \"steps\": [\n                {\"intent\": \"respond\" if selected.name == \"direct\" else selected.name,\n                 \"objective\": goal,\n                 \"constraints\": {}},\n            ],\n        }\n        return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"PlannerStage\"]\n"

  "content": "\"\"\"LearningStage — records learned lessons from reflection results.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport uuid as _uuid\n\nfrom core.pipeline.base import PipelineStage, StageOutcome, StageResult\nfrom core.pipeline.learning_result import LearningRecord\nfrom core.pipeline.pipeline import PipelineContext\n\n\nclass LearningStage(PipelineStage):\n    @property\n    def name(self) -> str:\n        return \"learning\"\n\n    async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:\n        services = getattr(context, \"services\", None)\n        reflection = getattr(context, \"reflection_result\", None)\n\n        records = []\n        if reflection is not None:\n            rid = services.uuid4() if services is not None and hasattr(services, \"uuid4\") \\\n                else _uuid.uuid4().hex\n            success_rating = float(getattr(reflection, \"success_rating\", 0.0) or 0.0)\n            record = LearningRecord(\n                learning_id=f\"lrn_{rid[:24]}\",\n                activity_id=getattr(reflection, \"activity_id\", \"\")\n                or getattr(context, \"activity_id\", \"\") or \"\",\n                reflection_id=getattr(reflection, \"reflection_id\", \"\"),\n                success_rating=success_rating,\n                confidence=float(getattr(reflection, \"overall_confidence\", 0.0) or 0.0),\n                patterns=tuple(getattr(reflection, \"patterns\", ()) or ()),\n                lessons=tuple(getattr(reflection, \"lessons\", ()) or ()),\n                store_decision=\"store\" if success_rating >= 0.5 else \"skip\",\n            )\n            records.append(record)\n\n        context.learning_records = tuple(records)\n        context.learning_result = {\"records\": len(records)}\n        return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"LearningStage\"]\n"

def _make_explainability_context(
    services: DeterministicServices,
    *,
    with_reasoning: bool = True,
    with_knowledge: bool = True,
    with_reflection: bool = True,
) -> PipelineContext:
    """Build a context with populated prior artifacts for explainability testing."""
    from core.pipeline.reasoning_result import Belief, ReasoningResult
    from core.pipeline.knowledge_result import KnowledgeResult
    from core.pipeline.reflection_result import ReflectionResult
    from core.pipeline.planner_result import PlannerResult, PlanRanking, StrategyComparison

    ctx = _make_context(services, "explainability test request")

    if with_reasoning:
        ctx.reasoning_result = ReasoningResult(
            reasoning_id=f"rsn_{services.uuid4()[:24]}",
            activity_id=services.uuid4(),
            beliefs=(
                Belief(belief_id=services.uuid4(), claim="The sky is blue", confidence=0.9, status="accepted"),
                Belief(belief_id=services.uuid4(), claim="Water is wet", confidence=0.8, status="accepted"),
            ),
            evidence=(),
            contradictions=(),
            counter_hypotheses=(),
            confidence=0.85,
            complexity="simple",
        )

    if with_knowledge:
        ctx.knowledge_result = KnowledgeResult(
            knowledge_id=f"kn_{services.uuid4()[:24]}",
            activity_id=services.uuid4(),
            entities=("entity_1", "entity_2"),
            facts=("fact_1",),
            edges=(),
            node_count=3,
            edge_count=0,
        )

    if with_reflection:
        ctx.reflection_result = ReflectionResult(
            reflection_id=f"ref_{services.uuid4()[:24]}",
            activity_id=services.uuid4(),
            question=ctx.raw_input,
            success_rating=0.8,
            overall_confidence=0.75,
            lessons=("test lesson",),
            patterns=("efficient_research",),
        )

    ctx.planner_result = PlannerResult(
        plan_id=f"pln_{services.uuid4()[:24]}",
        total_candidates=2,
        ranking=PlanRanking(comparisons=(
            StrategyComparison(winner_id="strategy_a", loser_id="strategy_b", margin=0.2),
        )),
        selected_strategy=None,
    )

    ctx.classification = {"mode": "research", "confidence": 0.8}
    ctx.execution_state = "completed"

    return ctx


async def _run_explainability_twice(
    *,
    with_reasoning: bool = True,
    with_knowledge: bool = True,
    with_reflection: bool = True,
) -> tuple[PipelineContext, PipelineContext]:
    a = _make_explainability_context(
        DeterministicServices.fake(),
        with_reasoning=with_reasoning,
        with_knowledge=with_knowledge,
        with_reflection=with_reflection,
    )
    b = _make_explainability_context(
        DeterministicServices.fake(),
        with_reasoning=with_reasoning,
        with_knowledge=with_knowledge,
        with_reflection=with_reflection,
    )
    ctx_a = await _run_explainability(a)
    ctx_b = await _run_explainability(b)
    return ctx_a, ctx_b

services = getattr(context, \"services\", None)\n        eid = services.uuid4() if services is not None and hasattr(services, \"uuid4\") \\\n            else _uuid.uuid4().hex\n\n        trace: list = []\n        findings: list = []\n\n        classification = getattr(context, \"classification\", None)\n        if isinstance(classification, dict):\n            mode = classification.get(\"mode\", \"unknown\")\n            trace.append(f\"classification={mode}\")\n\n        rr = getattr(context, \"reasoning_result\", None)\n        if rr is not None:\n            beliefs = tuple(getattr(rr, \"beliefs\", ()) or ())\n            trace.append(f\"reasoning=completed ({len(beliefs)} beliefs)\")\n            findings.extend(f\"belief: {b.claim}\" for b in beliefs[:3])\n        else:\n            trace.append(\"reasoning=skipped\")\n\n        pr = getattr(context, \"planner_result\", None)\n        if pr is not None:\n            strategies = tuple(getattr(getattr(pr, \"ranking\", None),\n                                       \"strategies\", ()) or ())\n            trace.append(f\"planning={len(strategies)}_strategies\")\n        else:\n            trace.append(\"planning=skipped\")\n\n        state = str(getattr(context, \"execution_state\", \"pending\"))\n        trace.append(f\"execution={state}\")\n\n        reflection = getattr(context, \"reflection_result\", None)\n        if reflection is not None:\n            trace.append(\"reflection=completed\")\n            lessons = tuple(getattr(reflection, \"lessons\", ()) or ())\n            findings.extend(f\"lesson: {l}\" for l in lessons[:3])\n        else:\n            trace.append(\"reflection=skipped\")\n\n        confidence = float(getattr(rr, \"confidence\", 0.0) or 0.0) if rr else 0.0\n        summary = (\n            f\"Request '{str(getattr(context, 'raw_input', '') or '')[:60]}' was \"\n            f\"processed through {len(trace)} stages; final state: {state}.\"\n        )\n        context.explanation = ExplanationResult(\n            explanation_id=f\"exp_{eid[:24]}\",\n            request_id=str(getattr(context, \"request_id\", \"\") or \"\"),\n            activity_id=str(getattr(context, \"activity_id\", \"\") or \"\"),\n            summary=summary,\n            confidence=confidence,\n            reasoning_trace=tuple(trace),\n            key_findings=tuple(findings),\n        )\n        return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"ExplainabilityStage\"]\n"

      class ExecutionStage(PipelineStage):
          def __init__(self, provider: Optional[Provider] = None, **kwargs: Any):
              self.provider = provider
              self.providers: list[Provider] = [MockProvider()]
              self._default_provider: Provider = provider or self.providers[0]
              self._runtime: Any = None
      
          @property
          def name(self) -> str:
              return "execution"
      
          def with_default_providers(self) -> "ExecutionStage":
              """Attach the real provider chain: Mock → LiteLLM → Ollama."""
              self.providers = [LiteLLMProvider(), OllamaFallbackProvider(),
                                MockProvider()]
              self._default_provider = self.providers[0]
              return self
      
          def register_provider(self, provider: Provider) -> "ExecutionStage":
              self.providers.insert(0, provider)
              return self
      
          async def execute(self, context: PipelineContext) -> StageResult:
              if context.execution_state == "failed":
                  return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.FAIL, context=context,
                                     error=context.error)
      
              # Empty input: nothing to execute.
              if not (context.raw_input or "").strip() and context.plan is None:
                  context.execution_result = {"text": "", "provider": "none",
                                              "tokens": 0}
                  return StageResult(outcome=StageOutcome.CONTINUE, context=context)
      
              # Custom runtime override.
              runtime = getattr(self, "_runtime", None)
              if runtime is not None and hasattr(runtime, "execute_plan"):

  "content": "\"\"\"ConfigRegistry — declarative env-var configuration entries.\n\n``_REGISTRY`` is the iterable of ConfigEntry consumed by the architecture\nboundary tests; ``register()`` adds entries, ``get()`` resolves values.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Optional\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ConfigEntry:\n    key: str = \"\"\n    env_var: str = \"\"\n    default: Any = None\n    description: str = \"\"\n    parser: Optional[Callable[[str], Any]] = None\n    metadata: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n\n# Iterable of registered entries (boundary tests consume this).\n_REGISTRY: list[ConfigEntry] = []\n\n\ndef register(entry: ConfigEntry) -> ConfigEntry:\n    _REGISTRY.append(entry)\n    return entry\n\n\ndef get(key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:\n    for entry in _REGISTRY:\n        if entry.key == key or entry.env_var == key:\n            raw = os.getenv(entry.env_var, \"\")\n            if raw == \"\":\n                return entry.default if entry.default is not None else default\n            if entry.parser is not None:\n                try:\n                    return entry.parser(raw)\n                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n                    return default\n            return raw\n    return os.getenv(key, default)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"ConfigEntry\", \"_REGISTRY\", \"register\", \"get\"]\n"
}

      class TestTenantResolutionPipelineIntegration:
          """Tenant resolution runs after authentication, before authorization."""
      
          async def test_stage_in_default_pipeline(self):
              from core.pipeline.stages import DEFAULT_STAGES
              names = [name for name, _ in DEFAULT_STAGES]
              assert "tenant_resolution" in names
              auth_idx = names.index("authentication")
              tenant_idx = names.index("tenant_resolution")
              authz_idx = names.index("authorization")
              # tenant_resolution must come between authentication and authorization
              assert auth_idx < tenant_idx < authz_idx
      
          async def test_pipeline_execution_populates_result(self):
              """End-to-end: process_message with identity produces tenant_resolution_result."""
              from core.pipeline import pipeline as pipeline_module
              from core.pipeline.messages import Request
      
              # Create a minimal pipeline with just the stages we need
              from core.pipeline.stages.tenant_resolution import TenantResolutionStage
      
              p = pipeline_module.Pipeline()
              p.add_stage(TenantResolutionStage())
      
              old_default = pipeline_module._default_pipeline
              pipeline_module._default_pipeline = p
              try:
                  response = await pipeline_module.process_message(
                      Request(text="hello", transport="test", user_id="user1"),
                  )
                  # process_message doesn't return ctx, but we can check metadata
                  # The tenant_resolution_result should exist after pipeline execution
                  assert "pipeline_version" in response.metadata
              finally:
                  pipeline_module._default_pipeline = old_default

          OBSERVATION_CREATED,

          reset_hub,
      )
      from core.observation.hub import _observation_hub
      from core.pipeline.observation import Observation
      
      
      @pytest.fixture
      def fresh_bus():
          return EventBus()
      
      
      @pytest.fixture
      def hub(fresh_bus):
          return ObservationHub(bus=fresh_bus)
      
      
      @pytest.fixture
      def sample_obs():
          return Observation.new(
              activity_id="act-1",
              source="test",
              type_="text",
              payload={"content": "hello"},
          )
      
      
      class TestPublishObservation:
          async def test_publishes_event_with_correct_type(self, hub, fresh_bus, sample_obs):
              events: list[Event] = []
      
              async def capture(e: Event):
                  events.append(e)
      
              fresh_bus.subscribe(OBSERVATION_OBSERVED, capture)
              await hub.publish_observation_async(sample_obs)
      
              assert len(events) == 1
              assert events[0].type == OBSERVATION_OBSERVED
              assert events[0].source == "observation.hub"
      
          async def test_payload_contains_observation_dict(self, hub, fresh_bus, sample_obs):
              events: list[Event] = []
      
              async def capture(e: Event):
                  events.append(e)
      
              fresh_bus.subscribe(OBSERVATION_OBSERVED, capture)
              await hub.publish_observation_async(sample_obs)
      
              payload = events[0].payload
              assert payload["id"] == sample_obs.id
              assert payload["fingerprint"] == sample_obs.fingerprint
              assert payload["activity_id"] == "act-1"
              assert payload["source"] == "test"
              assert payload["type"] == "text"
              assert payload["payload"] == {"content": "hello"}
      
          async def test_publishes_batch(self, hub, fresh_bus):
              events: list[Event] = []
      
              async def capture(e: Event):
                  events.append(e)
      
              fresh_bus.subscribe(OBSERVATION_OBSERVED, capture)
              obs_list = [
                  Observation.new(activity_id="a", source="test", type_="text", payload={"i": 1}),
                  Observation.new(activity_id="a", source="test", type_="text", payload={"i": 2}),
              ]
              await hub.publish_observations_async(obs_list)

class _IdentityCapturingStage(PipelineStage):
    """Minimal stage that captures identity for assertion."""

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "test_capture"

        self.captured = context.identity

        p.add_stage(capture)
        set_pipeline(p)

        req = Request(text="hello", transport="test", user_id="user-1", session_id="sess-1")
        resp = await process_message(req)
        assert resp is not None
        assert capture.captured is not None

        assert capture.captured.session is not None
        assert capture.captured.session.id == "sess-1"
        assert capture.captured.agent is not None
        assert capture.captured.agent.type == "test"
    finally:
        set_pipeline(old)

    async def test_propagation_replay_determinism(self):
        """Same request + same scope produces identical scope chain on replay."""
        scope = ResourceScope(tenant_id="replay-co", workspace_id="ws-r1",
                              owner_id="user-r", visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)

        async def run() -> dict:
            svc = DeterministicServices.fixed()
            ctx = await _run(_make_pipeline("replay chain"), svc,
                             raw_input="test", resource_scope=scope)
            obs_scopes = [o.resource_scope for o in ctx.outcome.observations] if ctx.outcome else []
            return {
                "outcome_scope": ctx.outcome.resource_scope if ctx.outcome else None,
                "obs_scopes": obs_scopes,
                "metrics_tenant": ctx.architecture_metrics.tenant_id if ctx.architecture_metrics else None,
            }

        r1 = await run()
        r2 = await run()
        assert r1 == r2

    async def test_replay_observation_fingerprints_match(self):
        svc = DeterministicServices.fixed()

        async def exec_once() -> list[Observation]:
            p = _make_pipeline("sunny")
            ctx = await _run(p, svc, raw_input="How are you?")
            return list(ctx.outcome.observations) if ctx.outcome else []

        obs1 = await exec_once()
        obs2 = await exec_once()

        assert len(obs1) == len(obs2)
        for o1, o2 in zip(obs1, obs2):
            assert o1.fingerprint == o2.fingerprint
            assert o1.source == o2.source
            assert o1.type == o2.type
            assert o1.payload == o2.payload

        async def exec_once() -> list[Observation]:

            ctx = await _run(p, svc, raw_input="say hi")
            return list(ctx.outcome.observations) if ctx.outcome else []

        r1 = await exec_once()

            assert o1.payload == o2.payload
            assert o1.source == o2.source

{
  "path": "core/observation/hub.py",
  "instructions": "ObservationHub full contract: to_dict payload, batch publish, subscribe with pattern, subscribe_stream",
  "content": "\"\"\"ObservationHub — fans observations out to subscribers over the EventBus.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Optional\n\nfrom core.event_bus import EventBus, Event\n\nOBSERVATION_CREATED = \"OBSERVATION_CREATED\"\nOBSERVATION_OBSERVED = \"OBSERVATION_OBSERVED\"\n\n\nclass ObservationHub:\n    \"\"\"Publishes observations onto the bus, preserving resource scope.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, bus: Optional[EventBus] = None) -> None:\n        self.bus = bus if bus is not None else EventBus()\n        self._observations: list[Any] = []\n        self._streams: list[asyncio.Queue] = []\n\n    # ── payload normalization ────────────────────────────────────────\n    @staticmethod\n    def _payload(observation: Any) -> dict:\n        if hasattr(observation, \"to_dict\"):\n            return dict(observation.to_dict())\n        return {\"observation\": str(observation)}\n\n    async def _emit(self, observation: Any) -> None:\n        self._observations.append(observation)\n        payload = self._payload(observation)\n        scope = payload.get(\"resource_scope\") or {}\n        event = Event(\n            type=OBSERVATION_OBSERVED,\n            source=\"observation.hub\",\n            payload=payload,\n            resource_scope=dict(scope) if isinstance(scope, dict) else {},\n        )\n        await self.bus.publish(event)\n        for q in list(self._streams):\n            await q.put({\"channel\": OBSERVATION_OBSERVED, \"payload\": payload})\n\n    # ── publishing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    async def publish_observation_async(self, observation: Any) -> None:\n        await self._emit(observation)\n\n    async def publish_observations_async(self, observations) -> None:\n        for obs in observations:\n            await self._emit(obs)\n\n    def publish_observation(self, observation: Any) -> None:\n        try:\n            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()\n        except RuntimeError:\n            asyncio.run(self.publish_observation_async(observation))\n            return\n        loop.create_task(self._emit(observation))\n\n    # ── subscription ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    def subscribe(self, handler: Callable, pattern: str = OBSERVATION_OBSERVED):\n        return self.bus.subscribe(pattern, handler)\n\n    def subscribe_stream(self) -> asyncio.Queue:\n        q: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()\n        self._streams.append(q)\n        return q\n\n    # ── introspection ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    @property\n    def observations(self) -> list:\n        return list(self._observations)\n\n\n_default_hub: Optional[ObservationHub] = None\n\n\ndef get_hub() -> ObservationHub:\n    global _default_hub\n    if _default_hub is None:\n        _default_hub = ObservationHub()\n    return _default_hub\n\n\ndef reset_hub() -> None:\n    global _default_hub\n    _default_hub = None\n\n\n# Backwards-compatible factory alias used by some callers.\ndef _observation_hub(bus: Optional[EventBus] = None) -> ObservationHub:\n    return ObservationHub(bus=bus)\n\n\n__all__ = [\"ObservationHub\", \"OBSERVATION_OBSERVED\", \"OBSERVATION_CREATED\",\n           \"get_hub\", \"reset_hub\", \"_observation_hub\"]\n"
}

  "path": "core/runtime/providers.py",
  "instructions": "Real ExecutionRuntime/RuntimeServices per replay contract",
  "content": "\"\"\"ExecutionRuntime + RuntimeServices — executes plans against runtime services.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Any, Optional\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass RuntimeServices:\n    memory: Any = None\n    observation: Any = None\n    scheduler: Any = None\n    metrics: Any = None\n    event_bus: Any = None\n    activity: Any = None\n\n\nclass ExecutionRuntime:\n    \"\"\"Runs a plan inside the runtime, publishing observations + metrics.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, services: Optional[RuntimeServices] = None) -> None:\n        self.services = services or RuntimeServices()\n\n    async def execute(self, ctx: Any, plan: Optional[dict] = None,\n                      **kwargs: Any) -> dict:\n        steps = (plan or {}).get(\"steps\", []) or []\n        texts: list[str] = []\n        for step in steps:\n            objective = str((step or {}).get(\"objective\", \"\"))\n            intent = str((step or {}).get(\"intent\", \"respond\"))\n            texts.append(f\"executed {intent}: {objective}\" if objective\n                         else f\"executed {intent}\")\n\n        output = {\"text\": \"\\n\".join(texts) if texts else \"\", \"steps\": len(steps)}\n\n        observation = self.services.observation if self.services else None\n        if observation is not None:\n            await observation.publish(ctx, {\n                \"type\": \"execution_result\", \"text\": output[\"text\"],\n            })\n        metrics = self.services.metrics if self.services else None\n        if metrics is not None:\n            metrics.record(ctx, {\"steps\": len(steps), \"state\": \"completed\"})\n        return output\n\n\n__all__ = [\"ExecutionRuntime\", \"RuntimeServices\"]\n"
}
